_meta.meaning: DENOMINATOR ONLY. No row here asserts that anything is implemented, tested, rendered, packaged or accepted. The specification remains the only product authority; this file is derived from it.

summary.reconciliation: lines vs statements: one line can hold more than one requirement sentence. 3360 keyword lines (2799 MUST-level) resolve to 5125 statements (3982 MUST). Quote the statement figure, and say so.

requirements.text: **CUI is the only permitted language for creating applications for 9to1 or through its application-creation tools.** Application-authored structure, styling, state declarations, interactions, behaviours, component composition and application orchestration must use the canonical versioned CUI language and its typed action/runtime contracts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > CUI application-authoring mandate

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > CUI application-authoring mandate

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > CUI application-authoring mandate

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > CUI application-authoring mandate

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > CUI application-authoring mandate

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > CUI application-authoring mandate

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Completion and acceptance

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Design references

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline

requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Export MUST use interoperable formats where practical and MUST NOT require the user to manually reconstruct data from screenshots or unrelated pages.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: 9to1 MUST maintain an inspectable data-flow inventory and processor/subprocessor register for hosted services.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts

requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Telemetry and product analytics MUST be purpose-limited, minimised and separated from message/document content unless that content is genuinely required for a specifically disclosed diagnostic purpose.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Sensitive content MUST NOT be collected merely to improve general analytics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Privacy-preserving aggregation/pseudonymisation SHOULD be used where it meaningfully reduces risk.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Children and other protected/vulnerable-user contexts MUST receive any higher protection required by the applicable LegalPrivacyProfile.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Age-related protections MUST NOT be implemented by collecting disproportionate additional identity data when a less invasive compliant mechanism is available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Security/privacy failures MUST fail closed where continuing would expose personal content or silently weaken a promised protection.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: If an encryption, permission, privacy-relay or policy control required for a sensitive operation is unavailable, the operation MUST stop or visibly degrade to a clearly described lower-protection mode only when the user is allowed to choose that mode.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: No app-specific specification may silently weaken this baseline.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: An app MAY impose stricter privacy rules.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Any exception to the Privacy Ceiling MUST identify the exact requirement, jurisdiction/product scope, necessity, user impact, data affected, compensating controls, approval authority and review/expiry date.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Privacy and data-protection baseline
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Privacy acceptance MUST include automated and manual tests for least-privilege access, unauthorised cross-app data access, cloud/local boundary enforcement, retention/deletion propagation, export correctness, consent/withdrawal, encryption-state truthfulness, metadata minimisation, log redaction, provider failure and jurisdiction-profile changes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > API parity requirement
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every 9to1 app must expose a first-party automation API whose action surface is exhaustive for user-accessible app functionality.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > API parity requirement
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: An authorised MCP, plugin, script, agent or other client must be able to perform anything the user can perform in the app through supported UI, subject to the same account, object, platform and security restrictions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > API parity requirement
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: APIs must not be intentionally limited to a small automation subset while important user actions remain UI-only.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > API parity requirement
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Language bindings may use a syntactically valid representation of the 9to1 namespace where a language cannot use 9to1 as a literal identifier; canonical app/action names and behaviour remain unchanged.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > API parity requirement
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: It must include read, create, edit, move, organise, import/export, collaboration, configuration, deletion/recovery and other actions that the corresponding user can perform.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > API parity requirement
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every action must declare its name, arguments/schema, result schema, required target-app permissions, risk level, whether it is reversible, whether it can produce external side effects, and the objects/scopes it affects.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Home permission broker
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A caller may submit the request to the broker, but the requested app action remains PendingApproval until Home grants it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Home permission broker
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The prompt MUST identify the requesting app/script/MCP, verified caller identity/origin when available, target 9to1 app, requested action names/scopes, elevated/destructive risk and affected object identifiers/counts whenever they can be determined before execution.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Home permission broker
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: If impact cannot be determined safely before execution, the prompt MUST display that impact as unknown rather than omit it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Home permission broker
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Permission requests MAY group actions only when they share the same caller identity, target trust boundary and compatible risk level, and the prompt exposes the complete grouped scope before approval.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Accept and Always Trust
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Before Always Trust is granted, Home must show a prominent warning that this level of access can allow the caller to read, modify or destroy user data without asking again.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Accept and Always Trust
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The temporary grant must show its remaining action count/time and can be revoked early.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Caller identity and trust binding
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Trust must be bound to a stable caller identity rather than a mutable display name.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Caller identity and trust binding
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Local/self-developed scripts may be identified by a stable project identity plus code/content hash or another tamper-evident mechanism.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Caller identity and trust binding
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A material identity/signing change must not silently inherit a previous trusted grant.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Caller identity and trust binding
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Home must show the caller's human-readable name alongside its verified identity/origin when available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Caller identity and trust binding
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Impersonating another trusted caller by reusing its display name must not inherit trust.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Risk classification and sensitive actions
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Apps must identify destructive, bulk-destructive, security-sensitive, permission-changing, credential-sensitive, externally consequential and otherwise high-risk actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Risk classification and sensitive actions
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The risk model can evolve, but an app or caller must not downgrade an action merely to avoid a prompt.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Risk classification and sensitive actions
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: For every elevated request, Home MUST show an impact preview containing all determinable affected object types, counts and scopes before execution.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Risk classification and sensitive actions
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Values that cannot be determined without performing the action MUST be shown as unknown.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Risk classification and sensitive actions
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Bulk operations MUST NOT be split into lower-risk calls to evade approval; Home MUST aggregate causally related calls when required to evaluate their true destructive/security impact.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Revocation, expiry and failure behaviour
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: If Home cannot display a required prompt, the action must not execute.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Audit and transparency
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every API request and permission decision MUST be auditable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Audit and transparency
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Block, trust, expiry, revocation and Always Trust changes MUST also be logged.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Audit and transparency
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The audit trail must distinguish a caller requesting an action from the target app actually executing it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Implementation rule
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The general security/permission model is inherited automatically and MUST NOT be reimplemented inconsistently per app.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Implementation rule
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: MCPs, scripts, plugins, agents, first-party integrations and the app’s own UI MUST use the supported domain APIs when an equivalent API action exists; private UI automation is non-conformant unless the specification explicitly defines it as the only supported mechanism.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Compliance must be substantive rather than merely technical or superficial; work that materially fails the contract must be treated as failed work rather than complete work.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 2. General Agentic Work > 2.1 Policy and Terms Compliance
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: All agentic work must comply with OpenAI's applicable usage policies, terms, safety requirements, and platform restrictions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 2. General Agentic Work > 2.1 Policy and Terms Compliance
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must not knowingly perform work that violates those requirements.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 2. General Agentic Work > 2.1 Policy and Terms Compliance
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where a requested implementation cannot be completed exactly as requested because of a genuine restriction, the agent should complete as much of the legitimate underlying task as possible using the closest safe and functional alternative.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 2. General Agentic Work > 2.2 Duty to Perform Requested Work
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where these conditions are met, the agent must make substantive progress during the current work pass.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 2. General Agentic Work > 2.2 Duty to Perform Requested Work
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: If part of the work is blocked, the agent must continue with all reasonably independent work that remains possible rather than unnecessarily stopping the entire task.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 3. Robustness and Usefulness > 3.1 Robust Work
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: All work performed by the agent must be robust.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 3. Robustness and Usefulness > 3.1 Robust Work
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must not deliberately implement only the happy path when reasonably foreseeable failure cases would make the resulting product unreliable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 3. Robustness and Usefulness > 3.2 Useful Work
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: All work performed by the agent must result in something genuinely useful for its stated purpose.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 3. Robustness and Usefulness > 3.2 Useful Work
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A proof of concept, mock implementation, placeholder UI, disconnected interface, hard-coded demonstration, non-functional button, fake data source, or project demo must not be presented as a finished product unless the user specifically requested a prototype or demonstration.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 3. Robustness and Usefulness > 3.2 Useful Work
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Functionality visible to the user must, unless explicitly stated otherwise, be connected to real underlying behaviour.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 3. Robustness and Usefulness > 3.2 Useful Work
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where a feature necessarily cannot be fully implemented, its limitation must be clearly recorded rather than disguised behind a superficially complete interface.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: All work must be fit for purpose.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose > 4.1 Subjective Test
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: It should:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose > 4.1 Subjective Test
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: preserve existing required functionality;

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose > 4.1 Subjective Test
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: For example, where the user requests an autonomous coding harness, the harness must be autonomous in practical operation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose > 4.1 Subjective Test
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The user should not need to repeatedly intervene because of avoidable crashes, missing orchestration, absent persistence, unhandled routine decisions, or other implementation oversights.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose > 4.2 Objective Test
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose > 4.2 Objective Test
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: a file manager should use established file-management concepts;

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose > 4.2 Objective Test
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: a browser should use familiar browser interactions;

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose > 4.2 Objective Test
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: a spreadsheet should behave as an interactive grid rather than a collection of unrelated form controls;

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose > 4.2 Objective Test
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: a terminal should follow established terminal interaction conventions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose > 4.2 Objective Test
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Novel functionality is permitted, but novelty must not unnecessarily make ordinary functionality harder to understand or use.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 4. Fitness for Purpose > 4.2 Objective Test
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Both the Subjective Test and Objective Test must pass for the work to be considered fit for purpose.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 5. Accessibility
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: All work must be accessible.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 5. Accessibility
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where applicable, the agent should account for:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 5. Accessibility
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Interfaces should use appropriate abstraction.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 5. Accessibility
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Accessibility must not be treated as a cosmetic afterthought.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 6. Professional Quality
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: All work must be professional.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 6. Professional Quality
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must avoid obvious visual shortcuts or implementation artefacts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 6. Professional Quality
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: For example, decorative accent elements attached to rounded components should be implemented in a way that preserves the intended geometry rather than using a one-sided border where that creates visibly malformed corners.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 6. Professional Quality
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must inspect the actual resulting interface where the available environment permits it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 7. Originality and Human-Like Design
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: All work must be sufficiently unique and intentional that a sober and reasonable person who is sceptical of AI-generated work would not immediately identify it as such from avoidable stylistic patterns.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 7. Originality and Human-Like Design
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must avoid formulaic AI-generated design conventions, including excessive reliance on:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 7. Originality and Human-Like Design
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: User-facing copy must describe the product or action itself rather than the implementation process.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 7. Originality and Human-Like Design
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Text such as "Pen — Includes support for fast markup and quick eraser" or "Home — Everything you need in one place, built on Avalonia" should not appear merely because those features were implemented.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 8. Substantive Contribution
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Each agentic development pass must make a substantive contribution proportional to the task requested and the time or scope made available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 8. Substantive Contribution
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where the user requests a large development pass, the agent must not substitute:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 8. Substantive Contribution
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Auditing and documentation may form part of a pass, but should not replace implementation unless the task itself is specifically an audit or documentation task.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 8. Substantive Contribution
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent should continue through logically related work while useful progress can safely be made.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 9. Feature Completeness
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must not describe work as "complete", "production ready", "finished", or equivalent where material required functionality remains knowingly absent or unverified.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 10. Existing Work and Regression Protection
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must respect existing work.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 10. Existing Work and Regression Protection
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Unless the user explicitly requests otherwise, the agent must preserve:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 10. Existing Work and Regression Protection
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must inspect the relevant existing implementation before replacing it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 10. Existing Work and Regression Protection
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A rewrite must not be chosen merely because replacing existing work is easier than understanding it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 10. Existing Work and Regression Protection
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Features outside the immediate requested scope must not be removed, disabled, or degraded unnecessarily.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 10. Existing Work and Regression Protection
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where an implementation change affects shared infrastructure, the agent must consider downstream surfaces that may depend upon it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 11. Source-Control Safety
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Agentic development must use source control safely.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 11. Source-Control Safety
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must not use destructive source-control operations where they risk deleting or overwriting user work unless the user explicitly authorised that consequence.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 11. Source-Control Safety
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: In particular, the agent should avoid unnecessary use of operations equivalent to:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 11. Source-Control Safety
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Before performing substantial repository modifications, the agent must establish:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 11. Source-Control Safety
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: and whether another process or agent may be modifying the same area.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 11. Source-Control Safety
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Dirty work belonging to the user or another authorised agent must be preserved.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 11. Source-Control Safety
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: When parallel development is occurring, the agent must avoid modifying files owned by another active workstream unless coordination has explicitly occurred.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 12. Repository and Environment Authority
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where a canonical repository, workspace, machine, environment, branch, directory, or deployment target has been specified, the agent must treat it as authoritative.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 12. Repository and Environment Authority
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must not silently substitute another environment because it is more convenient.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 12. Repository and Environment Authority
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Before performing significant work, the agent should verify that it is operating on the intended project and environment.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 12. Repository and Environment Authority
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: If the authoritative environment is unavailable but useful work can still be carried out elsewhere, the agent must clearly distinguish preparatory work from authoritative implementation and must not falsely claim that the authoritative environment was modified.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 13. No Fabricated Implementation
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must never claim to have:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 13. No Fabricated Implementation
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Unknown information must remain unknown until verified.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 14. Validation and Testing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Implementation must be followed by proportionate validation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 14. Validation and Testing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must test the behaviour it changed rather than relying solely upon static inspection.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 14. Validation and Testing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where applicable, validation should include:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 14. Validation and Testing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Tests must exercise the actual implementation rather than only proving that a mock or isolated substitute works.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 14. Validation and Testing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where a full test suite cannot run because of an environmental limitation, the agent must run the strongest relevant subset available and clearly identify the remaining unverified gate.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 14. Validation and Testing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A pre-existing unrelated failure must not automatically invalidate otherwise valid work, but it must be distinguished from failures caused by the current changes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 15. Visual Quality Assurance
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Any substantial user-interface implementation must receive visual review when an appropriate rendering or runtime environment is available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 15. Visual Quality Assurance
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent should inspect:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 15. Visual Quality Assurance
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Visual QA should identify issues such as:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 15. Visual Quality Assurance
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must fix material issues found during its own review before presenting the work as complete.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 16. Error Handling and Recovery
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Normal failure must be designed for.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 16. Error Handling and Recovery
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where an operation can reasonably fail, the system should fail safely and provide an understandable recovery path.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 16. Error Handling and Recovery
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Errors should not ordinarily result in:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 16. Error Handling and Recovery
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: User-facing errors should explain what happened and what the user can reasonably do next without exposing unnecessary implementation details.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 16. Error Handling and Recovery
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Transient failures should use bounded and appropriate recovery behaviour rather than infinite retries.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 17. Data Integrity
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Persistent user data must be treated conservatively.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 17. Data Integrity
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must avoid implementation choices that could reasonably cause accidental:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 17. Data Integrity
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Schema or format migrations should, where appropriate:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 17. Data Integrity
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Sample data must never silently overwrite genuine user data.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 18. Security and Privacy
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Security must be considered during implementation rather than deferred until after feature development.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 18. Security and Privacy
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where relevant, the agent must account for:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 18. Security and Privacy
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Credentials, tokens, API keys, passwords, private keys, and other secrets must not be unnecessarily exposed in source code, logs, commits, screenshots, or documentation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 18. Security and Privacy
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must follow least-privilege principles where practical.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 19. External Side Effects
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Actions affecting external systems must be treated differently from reversible local edits.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 19. External Side Effects
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Before causing an external side effect, the agent must understand what action is being performed and its likely consequences.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 19. External Side Effects
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where the user's request clearly authorises such an action, the agent should perform it using the authorised mechanism.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 19. External Side Effects
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must not create additional external side effects merely because they are convenient.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 20. Dependencies and Third-Party Software
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Dependencies must be chosen deliberately.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 20. Dependencies and Third-Party Software
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent should avoid adding unnecessary dependencies where existing project capabilities are sufficient.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 20. Dependencies and Third-Party Software
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Before introducing a significant dependency, the agent should consider:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 20. Dependencies and Third-Party Software
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Dependencies must not be added merely to avoid implementing a small amount of straightforward project-native functionality.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 21. Donor and Upstream Applications
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where an application or component is based on, forked from, or explicitly uses another application as its donor or upstream implementation, the donor source must be treated as authoritative reference material for inherited functionality.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 21. Donor and Upstream Applications
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The latest appropriate donor source should be obtained or referenced.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 21. Donor and Upstream Applications
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Existing donor functionality should not be recreated from memory when the actual implementation is available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 21. Donor and Upstream Applications
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Relevant features, quality-of-life behaviour, keyboard interactions, menus, workflows, and expected user-facing behaviour should be preserved or appropriately adapted.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 21. Donor and Upstream Applications
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Proprietary functionality that cannot be reused should be replaced with a project-native equivalent where required rather than leaving an unexplained gap.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 21. Donor and Upstream Applications
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Required copyright notices, licences, attribution, and source obligations must be respected.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 21. Donor and Upstream Applications
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The relationship between the derivative implementation and its donor should remain traceable in the project's development records.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 21. Donor and Upstream Applications
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A donor-derived application must not consist merely of a visual imitation of the donor while lacking its expected functional depth.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 22. Architecture and Maintainability
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must implement functionality in a maintainable way consistent with the architecture of the project.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 22. Architecture and Maintainability
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: It should avoid:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 22. Architecture and Maintainability
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: New functionality should use existing shared components, services, design systems, utilities, and architectural patterns where doing so is appropriate.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 22. Architecture and Maintainability
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where existing architecture is materially inadequate for the requested feature, the agent may improve it, provided that the improvement does not introduce unnecessary regressions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 23. Performance
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must consider performance where its implementation could materially affect normal product use.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 23. Performance
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Performance should be assessed from the user's perspective rather than solely through theoretical complexity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 23. Performance
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent should avoid introducing:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 23. Performance
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Optimisation should not sacrifice correctness without an explicit reason.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 24. Platform Compatibility
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where a project supports multiple operating systems, architectures, browsers, devices, or runtime environments, changes must account for the supported matrix.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 24. Platform Compatibility
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must not unknowingly introduce a dependency on the environment it personally used for development.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 24. Platform Compatibility
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Platform-specific behaviour should be isolated where appropriate.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 24. Platform Compatibility
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where comprehensive multi-platform testing is unavailable, affected platforms must be identified as unverified rather than implicitly claimed as validated.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 25. Delegation and Parallel Agents
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Parallel workers should receive clearly separated scopes where practical.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 25. Delegation and Parallel Agents
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Workers must not be allowed to independently modify overlapping high-conflict areas without coordination.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 25. Delegation and Parallel Agents
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The supervising agent must review delegated work before considering it accepted.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 25. Delegation and Parallel Agents
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Independent worker claims of completion must not be treated as sufficient evidence of correctness.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 26. Autonomous Operation
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where the user requests autonomous operation, autonomy must exist in practice rather than merely in branding.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 26. Autonomous Operation
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: An autonomous system should, within its authorised scope:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 26. Autonomous Operation
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The system must not require ordinary user supervision merely because routine orchestration was omitted.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 27. Loop and Failure Detection
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Autonomous agents must detect when they are no longer making meaningful progress.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 27. Loop and Failure Detection
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent should recognise patterns such as:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 27. Loop and Failure Detection
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: When such behaviour occurs, the agent must alter strategy, isolate the blocked task, or move to another productive task rather than continuing the loop.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 28. Scope Management
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The requested scope defines the minimum required work, not necessarily the maximum reasonable work.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 28. Scope Management
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent may implement closely related changes where they are reasonably necessary to make the requested feature robust, integrated, or production-ready.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 28. Scope Management
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: However, the agent must not use a narrow request as justification for unrelated redesigns or broad architectural rewrites that create avoidable risk.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 28. Scope Management
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Scope expansion should serve the requested outcome.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 29. Ambiguity
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Material ambiguity should be resolved rather than silently converted into arbitrary implementation decisions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 29. Ambiguity
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: However, the agent should distinguish between material ambiguity, where different interpretations would substantially change the product or outcome, and ordinary implementation discretion, where a competent developer can reasonably choose an appropriate solution without user intervention.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 29. Ambiguity
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Questions should be reserved for genuinely consequential ambiguity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 29. Ambiguity
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Minor implementation details should be resolved using:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 29. Ambiguity
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must not unnecessarily stop progress to ask questions that can be answered from available evidence.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 30. Evidence-Based Completion
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Completion claims must be supported by evidence.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 30. Evidence-Based Completion
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where appropriate, a completed development pass should be able to identify:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 30. Evidence-Based Completion
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must not use confident wording to conceal missing validation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 31. Documentation
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Material architectural, operational, or behavioural changes should be documented where future maintainers would reasonably need that information.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 31. Documentation
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Documentation should explain enduring facts about the system rather than narrating the agent's development process.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 31. Documentation
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Temporary commentary such as "The AI added this because..." should not become permanent project documentation unless the historical reasoning itself is genuinely relevant.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 31. Documentation
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Documentation must remain consistent with actual behaviour.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 31. Documentation
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Outdated documentation created by the agent should be updated as part of the same change where reasonably possible.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 32. No Placeholder Debt
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must not introduce placeholder implementation into production paths unless explicitly requested.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 32. No Placeholder Debt
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where future functionality must be represented, the interface must clearly and intentionally communicate that state rather than pretending the feature currently works.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 33. Integration Requirement
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Features must be integrated into the actual product.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 33. Integration Requirement
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent must consider relevant:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 34. Consistency Across Product Surfaces
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where multiple product surfaces share a design system, capability, data model, or interaction concept, new work must remain consistent with the rest of the product unless a deliberate difference is required.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 34. Consistency Across Product Surfaces
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent should reuse established:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 34. Consistency Across Product Surfaces
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Equivalent actions should behave equivalently across the product.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 35. Realistic User Workflow Testing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The agent should validate complete workflows rather than only isolated implementation details.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 35. Realistic User Workflow Testing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: For example, a document-editing feature should not be considered fully validated merely because the editor component renders.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 35. Realistic User Workflow Testing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The exact workflow MUST reflect how a real user is expected to use the feature, and APP-AC governs the evidence and stage claim.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 36. Completion Before Expansion
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where core functionality remains broken or incomplete, the agent should normally prioritise completing or stabilising it before adding speculative enhancements.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 36. Completion Before Expansion
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: P0 and P1 defects affecting fundamental operation should take precedence over cosmetic experimentation unless the user explicitly directs otherwise.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 37. Definition of Done
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A task may be declared done only when, within its requested scope:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 37. Definition of Done
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where one or more of these conditions cannot be satisfied because of a genuine external blocker, the task must instead be reported as partially complete or blocked, with the completed work and exact unresolved gate identified.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Agentic Work Operating Contract > 37. Definition of Done
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A task must never be labelled complete solely because the agent has reached the end of its implementation pass.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > 9to1-specific agentic rules
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: If a 9to1 app is based on a donor application/project, all donor features, user-visible behaviours and quality-of-life improvements must be ported unless technically impossible and explicitly documented.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > 9to1-specific agentic rules
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: When a target app declares support for an artifact type, links/embeds MUST reference the canonical underlying document/project/entity rather than create an unmanaged duplicate.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > 9to1-specific agentic rules
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Unsupported artifact/app combinations MUST fail explicitly rather than silently flattening, copying or losing functionality.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > 9to1-specific agentic rules
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every authorised mutable 9to1 artifact whose owning app exposes mutation APIs MUST be editable through Spaces using the owning app’s semantic/domain actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > 9to1-specific agentic rules
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Read-only artifacts MUST be surfaced as read-only with an explicit reason.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > 9to1-specific agentic rules
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Spaces MUST NOT substitute raw UI simulation for an available typed action.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > 9to1-specific agentic rules
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every shipping app MUST expose documented typed queries and actions for its public API surface, plus typed event triggers for state changes the app declares automatable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > 9to1-specific agentic rules
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Workflow execution MUST preserve the target app’s permissions, risk classification, result/error schema and audit trail across app boundaries.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > 9to1-specific agentic rules
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Cross-app examples are acceptance criteria, not optional demos.
