requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > 9to1-specific agentic rules
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Source presence or a successful build alone is never enough; parity, interaction, accessibility, platform/package and representative end-to-end journeys must be evidenced.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where an app declares a donor/upstream project, the implementation MUST contain the actual donor source (forked, vendored or otherwise included according to the repository architecture) in the app’s source tree/build graph.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Runtime installation MUST NOT require the user to separately download the donor application merely to obtain donor functionality.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The selected donor revision/version and local modifications MUST be traceable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Preserve and make accessible every feature of each version-pinned designated donor, except: (A) third-party paid/subscription/licensed functionality that cannot legally be provided for free; (B) proprietary donor AI surfaces, whose unique permitted capabilities migrate into Dulche and whose duplicated interfaces may be removed; or (C) features irreconcilably conflicting with 9to1's direction after a documented attempt to adapt or replace them (e.g., a fixed traditional animation workflow incompatible with Present's AI/node-based approach).

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Prefer equivalent capability through the new experience; UI parity is not required.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Write/Present/Data should benchmark familiar Docs/Slides/Sheets-style layout conventions, without copying branding or visual design; Picture should compare relevant capabilities of Paint, Photoshop, GIMP and Illustrator, recognising differing target audiences.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Approval tests must examine actual packaged screenshots at representative window sizes, keyboard navigation, density, alignment, hierarchy, overflow and discoverability.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Applications and non-model APIs must not receive protected Den context without explicit permission.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every app must document supported target platforms and accessibility standards, keyboard/focus navigation, screen-reader semantics, scaling, contrast and reduced-motion behaviour; verify these in packaged builds.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Missing approved budgets or untested required platforms block final acceptance rather than permitting invented numbers.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The supported OS/version/architecture matrix, installation/upgrade/uninstall expectations, file associations and recovery expectations must be declared per release.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Failure must not be hidden behind success-looking UI.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: No RCVP or Full PASS unless (1) CUI static and runtime conformance, (2) donor inventory/approved exceptions, (3) category-layout review and screenshot inspection, (4) packaged end-to-end workflows, (5) privacy/security/accessibility, (6) platform and performance evidence, (7) real cross-app integrations where required, and (8) independent acceptance are satisfied.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Integrating new features MUST preserve the strongest compatible existing functionality AND currently specified CUI layout, design, data identities and interactions; donor features are migrated into compliant controls rather than importing an obsolete UI.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Project retains its Files meaning and MUST NOT silently become a separate Projects app.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The distinction MUST be visible in the interface: arranging a file, editing that file, editing an authored block and creating an independent copy are different operations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The new surfaces MUST reuse CUI, Home services, the Shared Productivity Engine, the registered preview/editor system and the Node Graph Framework for their applicable capabilities.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Domain-specific nodes and objects extend those shared contracts; they MUST NOT create competing permission brokers, generic content-merge engines or parallel implementations of the same shared object.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Link, Prototype, Paths and Replay MUST have functional launch screens: New, Open/import, Recent, Pinned, Shared with Me and search, backed by real artifacts and permissions.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Each launch experience MUST be distinct from its working editor under LAUNCH-001–006, rather than a header or introductory section above it.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Returning to the app’s Home/start surface MUST preserve saved work and applicable unsaved/session state under LAUNCH-004.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Each editor MUST have a clear title/location area, save/sync state, history access, share controls and an explicit distinction between authoring and viewing/running.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Use a compact contextual command bar, a central work area, a collapsible navigation/outline or asset panel where required below, and an inspector for the current selection.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Panels MUST be resizable or collapsible, preserve useful user preferences and leave a usable work area at smaller sizes.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A Properties panel MUST not be the only way to perform ordinary creation, navigation or editing.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Labels MUST use the names in TF-01. Theme changes, reduced motion, contrast settings and scaling MUST apply to the actual editor, embedded content chrome and pop-ups.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Product controls MUST not expose development jargon such as raw schema IDs, worker status or implementation notes as their ordinary labels.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Pointer selection, multiple selection, keyboard focus, context menus, clipboard operations, undo/redo, rename and delete MUST follow the owning app and shared engine conventions.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Text-entry focus MUST prevent a canvas shortcut from deleting an object or moving the viewport while the user is typing.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Selection and contextual toolbars MUST identify the active object and the scope of the next action.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Spatial surfaces MUST provide pan, zoom, fit-to-content, fit-to-selection and an accessible outline/list alternative.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: They MUST distinguish moving an item from panning the surface and selecting an object from opening it.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Touch input MUST distinguish tap, long-press and drag, and provide a visible alternative to context menus.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Moving between an overview, a child container and a document MUST preserve the relevant selection, scroll/zoom position and navigation history.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Inline and pop-up editors MUST visibly identify the source document and whether edits affect the original.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Dismissal MUST NOT discard uncommitted edits.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: All surfaces MUST distinguish Loading, Empty, No matching results, Read-only, Offline/unavailable, Permission denied, Unsupported capability, Missing source, Saving, Saved, Unsynced changes and Conflict where applicable.

requirements.group_title: Shared UI, navigation and authoring behaviour
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A loading placeholder MUST NOT replace a recoverable draft or falsely represent an empty document.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every organisation object, document, authored block, placement, relationship, section, step, event, checkpoint and variant MUST have stable identity at its owning scope.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Names, row positions, coordinates and file paths MUST NOT be identity keys.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Format/schema versions, current/base revision, owner, storage location and permission references MUST survive save, reopen, sync and export/import through the supported native route.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A source reference MUST identify the canonical file/artifact, owning app, optional stable sub-object/section selector and revision policy.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Repeated appearances MAY have different local layout or labels while referring to the same original.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Renaming or moving a source MUST NOT detach references.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Deleting a selected source section produces a visible missing-section state; the app MUST NOT silently substitute the whole document or a different section.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Access to a container or composed document MUST NOT grant access to its sources.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Missing, offline and denied states MUST remain distinguishable only to the extent the caller is entitled to know them.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A share dialog MUST explain that referenced originals may require separate access; changing their grants is a separate explicit action.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The UI MUST preview the difference before a consequential operation.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Undo/redo MUST act on the same semantic operation and respect current revisions; it MUST NOT reverse unrelated collaborators' changes.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Mutations MUST be validated and committed atomically at the smallest user-visible boundary using stable operation identity and expected/base revisions.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Save failure MUST remain visible until durability is established.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Content and referenced assets MUST not be evicted while they are the only unsynced copy.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Native export/import MUST preserve the organisation/document structure, supported authored objects, reference identities, revision policies and required dependency manifest.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Portable exports that include source bytes require the source's export/copy permissions and MUST explain the resulting independent disclosure.

requirements.group_title: Common data, source references and recovery
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > Source & Donor Apps
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Static export is separately labelled and MUST disclose lost interaction; it is never a substitute for the native artifact.

requirements.group_title: Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X01 — Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Boards MUST be able to include a Flow or Binder as a page referencing the same canonical Link document.

requirements.group_title: Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X01 — Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: It MUST also support a Files Sheet as a live Files-owned organisation page, rather than mislabelling Sheet as a Link type.

requirements.group_title: Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X01 — Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The host page MUST identify the owning source, respect reader/editor capability, provide Open original and preserve navigation back to the Board.

requirements.group_title: Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X01 — Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A Binder or Flow placed on a Sheet MUST open through the Sheet's chosen policy while keeping the surrounding notes/files and viewport.

requirements.group_title: Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X01 — Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A Prototype embedded in Link, Boards or a Path MUST retain its actual model and permitted session-local controls, not become a screenshot while being described as interactive.

requirements.group_title: Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X01 — Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every supported combination MUST reference canonical entities; unsupported combinations show their exact limitation instead of silently flattening or cloning.

requirements.group_title: Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X01 — Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Spaces and the persistent AI bar MUST use the same typed APIs as the UI for authorised creation, organisation and editing.

requirements.group_title: Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X01 — Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The current artifact, selection, source scope, active variant and permissions MUST be supplied explicitly.

requirements.group_title: Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X01 — Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: AI suggestions that change organisation rules, dependencies, route logic or other significant behaviour must be inspectable and undoable.

requirements.group_title: Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X01 — Embeds, Boards pages and conversational editing
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Core manual workflows MUST remain usable when AI is disabled or unavailable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Variants actions live under the owning app's Variants capability, such as 9to1.Write.Variants; the shared implementation MUST not bypass that owner's semantics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every mutation request MUST include the target stable IDs, typed payload, operation/idempotency key and expected revision, or an explicitly declared create precondition.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Files.Organisation MUST expose Create/Get/List, UpdateSettings, AddReference, RemoveReference, Reorder and the type-specific operations: Project section CRUD and assignment; Sheet object/geometry/ink/shape/connector edits and opening policy; Tree group/node/connection edits plus separately authorised Tree-layout reads; Smart rule/scope/pin updates and membership explanation; Timeline date-source/assigned-range/period edits; Pipeline stage/gate/approval/transition/mapping actions; Catalogue field/schema/local-value/view edits; Stash order/position/review/compare selection; and Matrix axis/cell/membership operations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Generic command payloads MUST have registered typed schemas, not arbitrary unvalidated JSON.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Link MUST expose document creation and retrieval, block/container CRUD, ordering/geometry, source/section/revision-policy updates, outline/search, preview and export/import.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Prototype MUST expose object/property/component CRUD, formula/binding/relationship/event/action updates, validation, evaluation/run/stop/reset and session-input changes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Paths MUST expose step/route/content CRUD, validation, preview/test sessions, authored revision commit, StartAttempt, GetProgress, SubmitResponse, Advance, checkpoint/resume, Restart and confirmed progress deletion.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Reader-scoped progress actions MUST not allow changing another reader's attempt or the authored route.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Replay MUST expose source capability inspection, capture creation/start/pause/resume/stop, scope changes, checkpoints/annotations, event/checkpoint retrieval, historical preview, independent-copy requests, review/redaction and export/delete.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Variant APIs MUST expose branch create/list/get/rename/switch state, compare, merge preview, resolution, commit and archive/recover through each required owning app.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Action schemas MUST declare required target permissions, source permissions, reversible/destructive risk, external effects, limits and partial-success behaviour.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X02 — Canonical API action catalogue
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every action exposed by a context menu, keyboard command or editor control MUST be accounted for in the generated UI/API parity manifest.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Windows, 9to1-OS and browser/web MUST implement the useful core authoring and reader experiences for this tranche using the same canonical formats, account identity, domain APIs and permissions.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Native interfaces use CUI/Home; web uses the existing authenticated web-service contract and MUST not require arbitrary local filesystem/process access.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Any temporary read-only/limited-editing mode MUST still provide source-aware navigation, faithful content, accessible controls, per-user reading/progress state where supported and a visible explanation of unavailable authoring.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: No disabled authoring control may pretend to save.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Full Android/Go authoring parity remains required after the temporary fallback; existing stronger mobile functionality MUST not regress.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: At narrow sizes, navigation and inspectors become drawers or dedicated subviews, command overflow remains discoverable and pop-ups may use full-screen routes with preserved Back state.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Complex spatial authoring MUST provide fit and accessible structural alternatives, not an unreadable scaled-down desktop screenshot.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Large collections/graphs/documents MUST use bounded incremental loading, preview hydration, virtualisation and subscription cleanup.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Closed/off-screen embeds MUST not continue uncontrolled computation, media playback or capture.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Source resolution and exports MUST detect recursion and bound dependency traversal.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Query, evaluation, capture, import/export and merge limits MUST be declared by the relevant capability and shown before an operation that exceeds them; limits MUST not silently truncate content.

requirements.group_title: Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X03 — Platforms, responsive behaviour and resource limits
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Actual supported workload sizes and measured results MUST be recorded rather than invented completion claims.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X04 — Acceptance matrix and release evidence
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every numbered requirement group MUST have a traceable implementation and test mapping.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X04 — Acceptance matrix and release evidence
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Evidence MUST distinguish source/unit coverage from real UI, runtime, cross-app, provider and package validation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X04 — Acceptance matrix and release evidence
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The per-feature acceptance journeys above are mandatory minimums, not optional demonstrations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X04 — Acceptance matrix and release evidence
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The Files matrix MUST cover all ten organisation types as parent and nested target, recording the exact reason for any genuinely incoherent or unsupported provider combination.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X04 — Acceptance matrix and release evidence
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Tests MUST verify canonical IDs and actual content effects, not only screenshots of controls.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X04 — Acceptance matrix and release evidence
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Visual/accessibility QA MUST inspect desktop and narrow/touch layouts, keyboard-only operation, screen-reader names/structure, visible focus, dialog return focus, 200% scaling, themes/contrast and reduced motion.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X04 — Acceptance matrix and release evidence
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: API tests MUST repeat consequential UI operations and prove equivalent permissions, validation, idempotency and results.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X04 — Acceptance matrix and release evidence
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Recovery tests MUST interrupt source hydration, collection edits, native import/export, Prototype evaluation, Path progress writes, Replay finalisation and variant merge.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X04 — Acceptance matrix and release evidence
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Resource tests MUST use populated realistic collections, long Flows, nested Binders, branching Paths and captured multi-source histories; record workload, platform and observed results.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X04 — Acceptance matrix and release evidence
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The release evidence ledger MUST identify each group as VERIFIED, IMPLEMENTED-UNVERIFIED, MISSING or BLOCKED, with tested revision/build, platform, evidence and exact remaining exception.

requirements.group_title: Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: No legacy migration is required for genuinely new formats unless real existing data needs it; any such data MUST be inspected and preserved before a format change.

requirements.group_title: Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Where a low-level representation or provider adapter detail remains unspecified, workers MUST choose the narrowest coherent implementation consistent with these visible behaviours, version and document its contract, and validate it.

requirements.group_title: Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: This discretion MUST NOT be used to invent another product, drop a required control/workflow, weaken ownership or security, flatten a native format, conceal an unsupported platform or defer a named feature.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Every new UI action MUST use the same typed domain operation as automation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Before consumers implement against them, owners MUST publish the versioned action catalogue with exact argument/result schemas, affected stable IDs, owner/scope, required permissions, risk/reversibility, expectedRevision for writes, pagination for lists and operationId for replayable mutations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Public naming must remain within the existing canonical namespace conventions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Internal representations may vary only if these observable semantics remain compatible.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Persistent schemas MUST be versioned, revision-aware and crash-safe.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Workers may proceed in parallel only with non-overlapping owned files or explicit coordination.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Packaging changes must re-test app embeds and missing-app paths; chat placement changes must re-test memory, indexing, Voice/Spaces conversation continuity and Mesh; Cards/Study changes must re-test the shared progress service.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The implementation must deliver real connected behaviour, not documentation or UI stubs.

requirements.group_title: Integration acceptance and release exit gate
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: The acceptance ledger MUST cover every LE group and its inherited requirements with actual UI and API journeys, persistence/restart, permission denial/revocation, interruption/retry/recovery and platform/package evidence.

requirements.group_title: Integration acceptance and release exit gate
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Exercise a missing optional app during this journey and complete its trusted installation without losing context.

requirements.group_title: Integration acceptance and release exit gate
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Resource and reliability evidence MUST state actual hardware/platform, dataset size, active/inactive tab counts, timing and memory/storage observations.

requirements.group_title: Integration acceptance and release exit gate
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: No unbounded cache, polling loop or full-history rescan may substitute for bounded incremental behaviour.

requirements.group_title: Integration acceptance and release exit gate
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: Modularity and Spaces integration are complete only when every in-scope behaviour is integrated and verified, required inherited suites pass, artifacts install/run cleanly, and no unresolved mandatory failure is concealed.

requirements.group_title: Integration acceptance and release exit gate
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A remaining genuine external gate or approved scoped exception must identify the affected requirement/platform, impact and evidence; it does not count as verified functionality.

requirements.group_title: Integration acceptance and release exit gate
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts > TF-X05 — Open naming decision and implementation defaults
requirements.top_section: General engineering, privacy and acceptance contracts
requirements.text: A worker may not mark the scope complete merely because its allocated task list ended.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services
requirements.text: The single modular installer installs genuine required dependencies and the selected app; optional unrelated surfaces are not forced.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Product role and ownership
requirements.text: Other apps MUST consume Home-owned shared services through supported authenticated interfaces and MUST NOT silently launch incompatible private replacements when a Home service is unavailable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Product role and ownership
requirements.text: App-owned documents, projects and domain data remain owned by their respective apps/storage layers; Home MUST NOT become the only canonical copy of another app’s artifacts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Product role and ownership
requirements.text: On 9to1OS, Home Core may be a system component with the same service contracts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Home shell and navigation
requirements.text: Navigation destinations MUST preserve their own scroll/filter/selection state while the Home process remains active where practical.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Home shell and navigation
requirements.text: Deep links from notifications, Go, other apps or the OS MUST be able to open the relevant Home destination/object directly without first routing through the Dashboard.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: It MUST assemble permission-authorised cross-app information into a concise live brief and MUST derive every surfaced tile from identifiable source entities/events or an explicitly generated synthesis over identifiable sources.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: Dashboard tiles MAY surface upcoming Planner items, tasks, recent files/artifacts, project progress, reminders, travel/routes, Agent or Automation status, relevant Mail/messages, package/update state, storage/account warnings and other timely ecosystem context.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: Every actionable tile MUST use typed app actions; the Dashboard MUST NOT use raw UI automation to perform app mutations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: The Dashboard MAY expose a lightweight ask/action affordance, but its primary purpose is synthesis, prioritisation, status and quick action.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: The user MUST be able to add supported fixed/provider tiles, remove/hide tiles, resize tiles where the tile declares supported sizes, drag/reorder tiles, arrange tiles into the supported responsive layout, pin/lock tiles against automated movement and restore/reset a layout.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: The canonical DashboardLayout MUST use stable TileInstanceID values and store at least TileType, source/provider identity, position/order, declared size, user visibility state, pinned/locked state, tile-specific configuration and layout revision.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: Responsive rendering MAY adapt exact pixel/grid placement to the current window/device, but it MUST preserve the user’s semantic ordering/grouping and pinned constraints.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: Automated generation/reordering MUST NOT silently overwrite a newer manual layout revision.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: When a layout conflict occurs across synced devices, Home MUST preserve both revisions or resolve through an explicit revision/merge policy rather than blind last-write-wins.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: Dashboard settings MUST expose two independent user controls: AllowAIGeneratedTiles and AllowAIReorder.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: These controls are opt-in/opt-out independently; disabling one MUST NOT implicitly disable the other.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: When AllowAIGeneratedTiles = false, Dulche/Generative UI MUST NOT create new arbitrary Dashboard tile instances.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: Existing user-added/system/provider tiles remain usable, and AI MAY still generate content inside a tile whose explicit tile contract permits generated content.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: When AllowAIGeneratedTiles = true, Dulche MAY create contextually useful temporary or persisted tiles through the safe Generative UI/CUI schema.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: Generated tiles MUST declare provenance, the source entities/events they summarise, their lifetime/persistence policy and available typed actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: Generated tiles MUST NOT inject arbitrary executable code.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: When AllowAIReorder = false, Dulche MUST NOT move, resize, regroup, reorder or hide existing tiles.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: When AllowAIReorder = true, Dulche MAY optimise unpinned/unlocked tile placement according to user goals/context, but MUST NOT move or resize tiles marked pinned/locked, MUST preserve explicit hidden-tile choices, and MUST retain an undoable prior layout revision.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: AI layout changes MUST be attributable in Events/audit history and MUST be reversible.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: Apps and Home services MAY register Dashboard tile providers through a versioned provider contract.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: A provider MUST declare TileType, source app/service, supported sizes, required permissions, refresh policy, data dependencies, available actions, whether the tile can be instantiated manually, and whether its content may be generated/modified by Dulche.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: Tile data MUST remain source-backed.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: A tile provider that loses access to its source MUST enter an unavailable/stale state with an explanation rather than silently displaying fabricated current data.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dashboard
requirements.text: Permission revocation MUST prevent future refresh/access and purge or redact cached sensitive content according to the owning source’s policy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Apps surface and package management
requirements.text: It MUST show installed and available 9to1 apps/packages with stable PackageID/AppID, name/icon, installed version, available version, update channel, installation state, dependency/compatibility state, update availability and repair/rollback availability where supported.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Apps surface and package management
requirements.text: Home MUST support install, uninstall, update, repair, launch/open, channel/version selection where allowed and rollback to a validated previous package version where retained.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Apps surface and package management
requirements.text: Uninstalling an app MUST NOT silently delete user-created artifacts owned by that app.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Apps surface and package management
requirements.text: Artifact-retention/deletion MUST be a separate explicit operation governed by the owning app/storage semantics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Apps surface and package management
requirements.text: Package installation/update MUST use staged validation and atomic activation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Apps surface and package management
requirements.text: Integrity/signature verification, dependency resolution and Home/shared-service compatibility checks MUST complete before activation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Apps surface and package management
requirements.text: A failed activation MUST leave the previous known-good package usable when rollback data is available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Apps surface and package management
requirements.text: Haven and the installer/bootstrap client MUST consume one canonical package/update service and database.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Library
requirements.text: It MUST surface canonical references to authorised artifacts across 9to1 apps, including recent, favourite/pinned, shared, generated/created and app/type-filtered content where applicable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Library
requirements.text: Every Library entry MUST identify the canonical owning app, stable artifact/entity ID, display name, artifact type, relevant location/owner/share metadata and last-modified state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Library
requirements.text: Opening a Library item routes to the owning app/surface and MUST NOT create a duplicate artifact merely because the item is listed in Home.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Library
requirements.text: Library search/filter/sort MUST use the shared search/index service but enforce current permissions at query/open time.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Library
requirements.text: Revoked or deleted artifacts MUST not remain usable through stale Library entries.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Events
requirements.text: Events MUST aggregate authorised typed activity from apps/services such as Agent/Automation runs, package/update events, permission/trust decisions, important artifact changes, Mesh/device events, notifications and other meaningful system activity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Events
requirements.text: Each Event MUST have a stable EventID, timestamp, source app/service, event type, actor/caller identity where relevant, object/entity references, severity/category, human-readable summary and typed deep-link/action references where available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Events
requirements.text: Events MAY reference RequestID/ActionGraphID for AI/agentic activity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Events
requirements.text: Events MUST preserve source provenance and MUST NOT invent event history from generated summaries.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Events
requirements.text: Home MAY generate a concise natural-language digest of events, but the underlying event records remain the authority.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: It MUST aggregate model/catalogue information from configured providers rather than depend on one catalogue.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Search, filter and comparison MUST support model identity, provider/origin, modality, capabilities, architecture/parameter information when known, context limits, quantisation/format where known, local/cloud status, hardware-fit estimate, install/connection state, entitlement/cost class and privacy/residency information.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Discover MUST treat Chat, Image and Voice as first-class model categories.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Voice MUST NOT be buried under Audio: conversational/live voice is a primary model category because it has distinct runtime, quality and capability requirements.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Voice discovery MUST expose capability metadata such as Conversational compatibility, Monologue compatibility, Live Listener compatibility, Live Translate compatibility, visual understanding, tool/action support, streaming, interruption/turn-taking support, supported languages/accents and translation language pairs when known, one-way/bidirectional/multi-language live interpretation support, local/cloud execution, latency characteristics, privacy/residency and entitlement/cost.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Discover MUST recommend the highest-quality compatible Voice models/configurations for the user's required mode and constraints.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Recommendation dimensions MAY include reasoning quality, speech naturalness, speech-recognition accuracy, expressiveness, instruction following, turn-taking quality, interruption handling, long-form coherence, audio-context understanding, visual capability, tool reliability and latency.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Voice recommendations MUST be contextual rather than a single universal ranking.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Discover may surface labels such as Highest quality, Best for Conversational, Best for Monologue, Best for Live Listener, Best for Live Translate, Best local and Fastest when supported by actual capability/evaluation data.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Each recommendation MUST explain the relevant reasons/constraints rather than presenting an unexplained badge.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Live Translate recommendations should consider speech-recognition accuracy, translation quality, output-speech quality, latency, turn detection, code-switching and multi-language support where measured.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Discover MAY recommend either a native realtime Voice Model or, where 9to1 supports it, a compatible composite voice configuration.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Composite implementation detail is secondary to the normal user-facing Voice selection and MUST NOT force ordinary users to manually assemble STT/reasoning/TTS pipelines.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: When a selected Voice Model exposes multiple named voices, Discover MUST show those voices as selectable variants with the underlying Voice Model as secondary metadata.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: A model listing MUST preserve stable provider-scoped identity even when multiple providers expose the same human-readable model name.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Unknown metadata MUST remain unknown rather than being fabricated.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Discover
requirements.text: Discover MUST support the relevant install/pull/connect/open-in-picker action for providers that expose those capabilities.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker
requirements.text: Apps, Agents and AI surfaces MUST NOT create incompatible private model pickers, provider registries or fallback logic when this shared capability applies.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Simple defaults and capability categories
requirements.text: The user may instead choose one Active Model/Route and allow all compatible capabilities to inherit it, with ordered fallback resolving unsupported capabilities.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Simple defaults and capability categories
requirements.text: Inheritance means use that ordered route and its native image-generation/editing-capable candidates; it MUST NOT silently substitute an unrelated unconfigured image provider.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Simple defaults and capability categories
requirements.text: These category routes may inherit the Active route or use explicit independent ordered routes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Active and Background routes
requirements.text: Users may configure a single Active Model/Route for all foreground AI work or assign capability-specific/app/Agent overrides.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Active and Background routes
requirements.text: A task-specific explicit model outranks Agent/app/category defaults; a configured Background route applies only to eligible background work and MUST NOT override an explicit Agent/task requirement.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Ordered Model Routes
requirements.text: Home/Dulche MUST support versioned ordered Model Routes shared by regular 9to1 and 9to1-OS.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Ordered Model Routes
requirements.text: Example: an Active route may be ChatGPT 6 Sol → Gemma 4 → Fable 5.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Ordered Model Routes
requirements.text: The router MUST evaluate compatibility before invocation rather than deliberately sending impossible requests to higher entries first.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Ordered Model Routes
requirements.text: Foreground and background workloads may use different ordered routes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Eligibility-first routing
requirements.text: A lower candidate may be used automatically when a higher candidate is unavailable because of a classified routing condition such as usage/quota exhaustion, provider/model outage, unsupported required capability, context incompatibility, authentication/provider unavailability when another authorised option exists, or local resource insufficiency after permitted reclamation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Eligibility-first routing
requirements.text: Capability mismatch should normally be detected before invocation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Conditions that are not model fallback
requirements.text: Errors such as missing user files, invalid tool arguments, target-app permission denial, required human approval, business-logic rejection or an external service action failure do not justify silently switching models unless the failure is independently classified as a model/provider-routing condition.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Fallback privacy and control
requirements.text: A request explicitly pinned to a model with fallback disabled MUST fail transparently rather than silently substitute another model.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Routing transparency
requirements.text: This metadata may be surfaced subtly in normal UI and in more detail through diagnostics/Action Graph without cluttering every response.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Selection inheritance and overrides
requirements.text: The configuration hierarchy MUST be deterministic: request-specific explicit selection → Agent/task override → app/surface override → capability/category route → Background route for eligible background work or Active route for foreground work → configured route fallbacks.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Selection inheritance and overrides
requirements.text: LLM Space and Desktop Space overrides MAY exist but remain scoped.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Selection inheritance and overrides
requirements.text: Category overrides are independent; for example an LLM Space may override Chat while inheriting global Image/Voice/Audio/Video routes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Reasoning and capability validation
requirements.text: It MUST NOT invent Low/Medium/High controls for a model that does not support them.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Aliases and model identity
requirements.text: Aliases are presentation conveniences and may be duplicated; all routing objects store stable provider-scoped Dulche ModelID values so duplicate names never create ambiguous execution.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Provider support
requirements.text: Routes may contain compatible local runtimes, configured commercial/cloud providers, self-hosted/OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Ollama, another Dulche device, enterprise endpoints and authorised provider/Plugin implementations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Resource awareness
requirements.text: For local candidates the picker may show estimated RAM/VRAM requirement, current availability, loading state and reclaimable resources when known.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Universal Model Picker > Administrator and managed-profile policy
requirements.text: Managed profiles may limit approved models/providers, acquisition, external cloud use, maximum cost/usage class or fallback destinations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dulche runtime control
requirements.text: It MAY host multiple logical endpoints/models concurrently subject to resource policy, but apps MUST attach to the shared broker rather than launching competing private model servers.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dulche runtime control
requirements.text: Home MUST expose shared Dulche service state including Starting, Ready, Degraded, Restarting and Stopped plus endpoint/model load state, resource pressure and health/diagnostic information required for recovery.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dulche runtime control
requirements.text: If the visible Home shell closes, Home Core MAY continue in the background.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Haven and shared platform services > Dulche runtime control
