requirements.text: Home/Dulche must provide a USER-VISIBLE PER-APP permission screen for context access, including consent to specific context categories/purposes, allow/ask/deny where relevant, scopes, current grants, expiry, revoke and audited access, with default denial for unauthorised apps or newly requested privileged scopes.

requirements.group_title: UCML APP PERMISSIONS, OUTPUT CONTROL, AND PROMPT-INJECTION DEFENCE
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: Shared/team context must be specifically authorised, and temporary chats/closed-source corpus restrictions are upheld.

requirements.group_title: UCML APP PERMISSIONS, OUTPUT CONTROL, AND PROMPT-INJECTION DEFENCE
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: Stream/output secret-pattern redaction remains OPTIONAL DEFENCE IN DEPTH, never a substitute for not exposing keys.

requirements.group_title: DULCHE BUILT-IN SAFETY BLOCK: CONTEXTUAL LOW-OVERHEAD CHECKS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: A lightweight CPU-friendly streaming detector MAY flag risk signals/patterns, but simple blacklisted WORDS, WORD PAIRS or short topic lists are NOT sole evidence of policy violation.

requirements.group_title: DULCHE BUILT-IN SAFETY BLOCK: CONTEXTUAL LOW-OVERHEAD CHECKS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: Words with common benign legal, educational, historical, fictional or technical uses must receive CONTEXTUAL classification rather than automatic refusal.

requirements.group_title: DULCHE BUILT-IN SAFETY BLOCK: CONTEXTUAL LOW-OVERHEAD CHECKS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: Assessment should consider user intent, whether a request is actually prohibited, severity, legitimate educational/helpful exceptions, and the true capabilities of the chosen model/tool.

requirements.group_title: DULCHE BUILT-IN SAFETY BLOCK: CONTEXTUAL LOW-OVERHEAD CHECKS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: A reviewer may run asynchronously AFTER low-risk material where safe; genuinely high-risk material/tool actions can be HELD before output or execution.

requirements.group_title: DULCHE BUILT-IN SAFETY BLOCK: CONTEXTUAL LOW-OVERHEAD CHECKS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: Response latency should be optimised and measured rather than promising zero overhead or relying exclusively on text scanning.

requirements.group_title: PROPORTIONATE SAFETY ENFORCEMENT, REVIEW AND MEMORY INTEGRITY
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: Where a response is actually adjudicated disallowed, use a clear policy-appropriate refusal or unavailable-content state (“Sorry - I can't respond to this request” may be used when accurate); do not replace legitimate educational/safety/helpful content simply because of a keyword.

requirements.group_title: PROPORTIONATE SAFETY ENFORCEMENT, REVIEW AND MEMORY INTEGRITY
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: When content legitimately must become unavailable, make rendering/export and related references enforce the adjudicated visibility decision with proper provenance and necessary audit retention; do not pretend historic physical-side effects were undone.

requirements.group_title: PROPORTIONATE SAFETY ENFORCEMENT, REVIEW AND MEMORY INTEGRITY
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: Memory derived solely from conclusively invalid/deleted user data may be reviewed for targeted invalidation under canonical Memory provenance and retention rules, but no broad automatic erasure of unrelated/valid memories or silent history destruction.

requirements.group_title: HOME USER CUSTOM BLACKLISTS AND OUTPUT-STYLE FILTERS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: Home settings MUST support user-configurable:

requirements.group_title: HOME USER CUSTOM BLACKLISTS AND OUTPUT-STYLE FILTERS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: These controls must be real versioned Home-owned account preferences, ideally with supported explicitly selected per-Space overrides, and persist/recover/synchronise within normal permissions.

requirements.group_title: HOME USER CUSTOM BLACKLISTS AND OUTPUT-STYLE FILTERS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: Lightweight local filtering SHOULD avoid unnecessary extra model turns; where a meaning-preserving rewrite is not safe, explain or mark an exception instead of corrupting data.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: MANDATORY INDEPENDENT REAL-PRODUCT TESTS before VERIFIED:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: B. Test every reaction value and its stored feedback scope, optional contextual AI reaction reply, and a deliberately confirmed Inappropriate report to Support@CakeMods.com with minimal disclosed payload, recorded delivery/retry and no silent whole-conversation export.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: All must inherit canonical CUI themes, screen reader/touch/keyboard/reduced-motion, native/browser platform-specific support, authentic persistence and current build/Task/Message revisions.

requirements.group_title: PEER REVIEW MAX REVIEW TIME: PRECISE ACTIVE-TIME DENOMINATOR
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: Review after each checkpoint or adaptive intervals draws from the SAME budget, including deliberation with workers, reinspection and intervention-related review activity; reviewers must not hide their time in the worker counter or create additional independent caps.

requirements.group_title: PEER REVIEW MAX REVIEW TIME: PRECISE ACTIVE-TIME DENOMINATOR
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: This percentage is an overhead LIMIT, NOT a quota peer review must consume and NOT a guarantee of review completeness.

requirements.group_title: PEER REVIEW MAX REVIEW TIME: PRECISE ACTIVE-TIME DENOMINATOR
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Dulche, nodes and agentic runtime > Shared conversation actions, composer, peer review and Dulche context
requirements.text: Never use budget exhaustion to bypass a required human approval, acceptance test or safety review.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Product role
requirements.text: Spaces operate on canonical app entities through their owning typed APIs and MUST NOT duplicate mutable 9to1 artifacts merely to make them conversational.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Product role
requirements.text: Spaces MUST support cross-app actions including Write document mutation, Board/embedded-Canvas editing, Data updates, Planner mutation, Maps route creation, media/project-file actions, Build operations and Automation coordination whenever the target app exposes the corresponding API.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Product role
requirements.text: Spaces MUST NOT fall back to raw UI automation when a typed action exists.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: Study is the learning environment and MUST support source-backed explanation, topics, practice questions, quizzes, flashcards, progress/weak-area tracking and review scheduling.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: Study progress MUST be based on recorded interactions/answers rather than inferred solely because material was shown to the user.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: Tasks is the goal-oriented work environment and MUST expose structured objective, plan/steps, current step, dependencies, blockers, approvals, outputs, status and run state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: It MUST preserve source/provenance and MUST NOT treat generated claims as product facts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: It MUST make source scope and outside-web access explicit.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: For conversational translation into multiple target languages, each language variant MUST render as its own assistant speech bubble rather than being collapsed into one combined multi-language response card.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: The bubbles remain siblings of the same TranslationSetID/request so retry, edit, regenerate, apply or publish operations may target one language without losing the others.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: Every active Experience MUST maintain canonical structured experience state rather than treating generated narrative prose as the sole source of truth.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: Experience state MAY include world/scene/time, characters, relationships, inventory/resources, objectives, flags, timeline, hidden information, rules and typed domain-specific state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: When the narrative says a state-changing event occurred, the corresponding canonical state transition MUST be committed before future turns rely on it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: Experiences MAY use persistent Dulche Agents for autonomous characters/roles that genuinely benefit from independent identity, memory or goals, while lightweight characters MAY remain scoped experience actors/state rather than becoming permanent Den Agents.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: Agent knowledge and private/hidden state MUST be filtered by the Experience visibility policy so one character cannot access information it has not learned.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: Experiences SHOULD support checkpoints, rewind and branching.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: Rewind/branch of simulated state MUST NOT pretend to undo real external side effects that already occurred through authorised Plugins/actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: Experiences MAY expose maps, inventories, evidence, character panels, timelines, objectives, cards or other interactive elements through safe CUI/Generative UI.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space types
requirements.text: Experiences MAY launch or embed a formal Play Match when the scenario requires a structured competition, and Play MAY offer Continue in Experiences for an open-ended continuation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > User-created Spaces and nesting
requirements.text: Spaces MAY be nested through ParentSpaceID to create logical hierarchies.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > User-created Spaces and nesting
requirements.text: Nesting MUST preserve each Space’s stable identity and MUST NOT imply permission escalation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > User-created Spaces and nesting
requirements.text: Child inheritance of sources, connected apps, model policy, memory, Skills, Plugins or Agents must be explicit/inspectable; a child cannot regain a capability or permission explicitly denied by a parent/security policy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > User-created Spaces and nesting
requirements.text: Edit Spaces MUST support reorder, nest/unnest, rename, icon, sharing, inheritance configuration, duplicate, archive/delete/recover and other structural management without exposing protected first-party internal implementation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sidebar and navigation
requirements.text: Its top control MUST display the currently selected Space and provide a Space switcher when activated; an adjacent overflow control provides quick actions for that Space.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sidebar and navigation
requirements.text: New Chat and the selected Space's required actions remain usable. + New Space and Edit/Manage Spaces expose the canonical builder and management workflows.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sidebar and navigation
requirements.text: Space-relevant options are typed capabilities/surfaces appropriate to the selected Space and may include Sources, Files/context, Topics, Progress, Runs, Findings, Tools, Agents, Approvals, Settings or custom sidebar items.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sidebar and navigation
requirements.text: The set is context-sensitive but MUST be deterministic and inspectable, not arbitrary hidden AI-generated navigation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sidebar and navigation
requirements.text: It MUST NOT create another Space.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sidebar and navigation
requirements.text: Recent/pinned conversations may appear within the selected Space’s Chat/conversation surface without turning the global sidebar into an unbounded cross-Space history list.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: Plugins MUST support contributing custom sidebar elements.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: An element MUST be able to open an arbitrary configured page/URL, an authorised app surface, an authored CUI page or a generative page, or invoke an Automation or another declared authorised action.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: Navigation and action-triggering behaviour MUST be explicit.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: For each Plugin, the user MUST be able to select which Spaces display its sidebar elements.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: This selection MUST be inspectable, editable and persisted using stable Plugin, Space and SidebarItem identities.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: An excluded Space MUST NOT display that Plugin's sidebar contributions merely because the Plugin is installed globally.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: Sidebar visibility is distinct from permission to execute the Plugin or access Space data; it MUST NOT silently change either.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: Attaching a Plugin MUST now be the primary method of supplying custom sidebar elements in custom Spaces.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: Ordinary Plugin-provided sidebar elements MUST NOT require users to construct a built-in Automation or Space lifecycle graph solely to load the element.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: The existing built-in automation/Events & Extensions/full Space graph mechanisms for loading, showing and controlling custom sidebar elements MUST remain supported for enhanced and combined workflows.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: Plugin and graph routes MUST share the existing sidebar identity, ownership, lifecycle and rendering contracts, preserving AppSurface, CUI and GenerativeUI support.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: They MUST NOT duplicate the same contribution or replace protected first-party sidebar items.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility
requirements.text: Disabling or detaching a Plugin MUST stop its active contributions without leaving executable orphan actions or deleting unrelated Space content.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility > Plugin sidebar — supplied concept mockup clarification
requirements.text: Plugin-contributed sidebar elements MUST support this ordinary navigation-row presentation: an icon on the left, a readable text label beside it, and alignment, spacing and interaction treatment consistent with neighbouring sidebar items.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility > Plugin sidebar — supplied concept mockup clarification
requirements.text: A custom entry can sit directly beneath New Chat within the selected Space's permitted custom-sidebar area; it MUST NOT require opening a separate Plugin panel simply to reach the entry.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility > Plugin sidebar API and acceptance
requirements.text: Extend the canonical Plugin and Spaces APIs for contribution registration, configuration, removal, per-Space visibility and authorised action dispatch; UI and API MUST use the same stable SidebarItemID and ownership/lifecycle rules.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility > Plugin sidebar API and acceptance
requirements.text: The original automation/Events & Extensions/Space-graph contribution route MUST continue to work, including combined workflows without duplicate contributions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins — custom sidebar elements and per-Space visibility > Plugin sidebar API and acceptance
requirements.text: The Plugin manifest and Builder MUST expose these contribution contracts rather than creating a second sidebar registry.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Canonical Space and conversation model
requirements.text: Space MUST contain at least SpaceID, SpaceOrigin, built-in type where applicable, Name, Icon?, ParentSpaceID?, owner/scope, instructions/configuration, model policy, context/source policy, memory policy, capability bindings, permissions, created/modified timestamps and revision metadata.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Canonical Space and conversation model
requirements.text: Conversation MUST contain at least ConversationID, SpaceID, Title, CreatedAt, ModifiedAt, ActiveBranchID, optional model override and revision metadata.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Canonical Space and conversation model
requirements.text: Messages MUST have stable MessageID, author principal/role, branch/parent relationship, timestamp, content blocks, model/provider provenance where AI-generated and tool/action references where applicable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Conversation branching and history
requirements.text: Editing an earlier message, regenerating a response or branching from a message MUST preserve prior history as a conversation branch rather than silently destroying descendants.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Conversation branching and history
requirements.text: Users MUST be able to return to earlier branches and identify which branch is active.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Conversation branching and history
requirements.text: Tool calls and consequential actions already executed remain historical facts attached to their original run/branch and MUST NOT be retroactively undone merely because text was regenerated.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Stop and resume
requirements.text: While a response/run is active, Spaces MUST expose Stop.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Stop and resume
requirements.text: Request states MUST distinguish at least Queued, Running, Stopping, Stopped, Completed, Failed, Cancelled and Blocked.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Stop and resume
requirements.text: A stopped run MUST retain RequestID, conversation/message linkage, selected model/provider policy, context references/snapshot metadata, completed tool/action records, Action Graph, Subagent state/checkpoints and remaining budget/limits where applicable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Stop and resume
requirements.text: Resume MUST NOT repeat already-completed consequential actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Stop and resume
requirements.text: If the provider cannot literally resume a token stream, Dulche may continue from persisted checkpoint/context while preserving the same user-visible continuation semantics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Model selection
requirements.text: Spaces MUST use the Universal Model Picker.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Model selection
requirements.text: Switching model mid-conversation MUST NOT rewrite provenance of prior responses.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Model selection
requirements.text: Every AI response/run must retain effective model/provider identity and relevant policy provenance.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sources and context
requirements.text: Spaces context MUST be represented as explicit typed references rather than opaque prompt stuffing.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sources and context
requirements.text: Each context/source reference MUST retain stable source identity, revision/change token where applicable, permission state and ingestion/index state where required.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sources and context
requirements.text: Spaces must be able to detect that a referenced source has changed rather than treating an old snapshot as current.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sources and context
requirements.text: A Sources/Context surface MUST let the user inspect what is attached, where it came from, current revision/availability, whether it is included automatically, ingestion/index status and remove/disable controls.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sources and context
requirements.text: Spaces MUST NOT rely on mysterious hidden context for ordinary operation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Sources and context
requirements.text: Dragging/adding a folder SHOULD create a folder reference plus scope/filter configuration rather than eagerly duplicating every contained file.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Context budgeting and retrieval
requirements.text: When available material exceeds the selected model’s context, Dulche/Spaces MUST use deterministic context selection/retrieval.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Context budgeting and retrieval
requirements.text: Required/current selection and explicit attached sources take priority over optional historical context.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Context budgeting and retrieval
requirements.text: Retrieval/summarisation/omission decisions MUST be represented in run logs/Action Graph sufficiently for inspection.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Context budgeting and retrieval
requirements.text: Spaces MUST NOT claim that an answer considered an entire source set when only a subset was retrieved.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Context budgeting and retrieval
requirements.text: Source-grounded modes must retain provenance for the chunks/entities actually used.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Canonical artifact editing
requirements.text: Any authorised mutable 9to1 document/project/entity whose owning app exposes domain APIs MUST be openable/editable from Spaces without creating a duplicate canonical copy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Canonical artifact editing
requirements.text: Spaces MAY host an embedded artifact surface alongside conversation, but the artifact retains its owning app identity, revision history and permissions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Canonical artifact editing
requirements.text: Spaces MUST support direct low-risk edits when clearly requested and reviewable proposed-change workflows for larger/ambiguous mutations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Canonical artifact editing
requirements.text: Review UI MUST correspond to actual typed target-app actions/diffs and MUST NOT present a fabricated text-only diff disconnected from the canonical artifact.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shared Productivity Engine
requirements.text: Spaces MUST use Home’s Shared Productivity Engine for supported rich content/object rendering and editing.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shared Productivity Engine
requirements.text: Pasted or embedded tables, code blocks, images, drawings, graphs and other shared objects MUST preserve shared schema/formatting and remain editable through the same object actions used by Write, Present, Canvas and Boards.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shared Productivity Engine
requirements.text: AI-generated shared-engine objects SHOULD be directly transferable to supporting apps without reconstructing them from rendered text/images.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins, Skills and Agents
requirements.text: Space capability bindings MUST support inherited availability plus explicit per-Space enable/disable/exclusion and optional version pinning where the underlying package/Agent contract supports it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins, Skills and Agents
requirements.text: Space bindings reference canonical Dulche package IDs/versions and Agent IDs; they MUST NOT clone package/Agent definitions into the Space.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Plugins, Skills and Agents
requirements.text: Availability does not grant permission: a Space may see a Plugin/Skill/Agent while still requiring the normal permission/trust decision before protected actions execute.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shared node-editor framework
requirements.text: Graph connections MUST be typed.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shared node-editor framework
requirements.text: Incompatible connections MUST be rejected or require an explicit conversion node.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shared node-editor framework
requirements.text: Graph nodes MUST reference stable canonical app/capability IDs rather than UI coordinates or screen controls.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space Events & Extensions editor
requirements.text: Allowed extension hooks may include Space loaded/activated/deactivated/closed, conversation created/opened, response started/stopped/resumed/completed and relevant type-specific events such as Study session started/completed, Task started/blocked/completed, Research run completed, Translate Translation Set/job completed, Experience started/checkpointed/branched/completed or Agent run state changed.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space Events & Extensions editor
requirements.text: Allowed extension actions may include Set Do Not Disturb, send Home notification, add/remove allowed context, open app/entity, create Planner item, invoke Automation/Agent/Skill/Plugin/permitted MCP capability, update extension-owned Space variables and add/show custom sidebar surfaces.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space Events & Extensions editor
requirements.text: The built-in extension editor MUST NOT allow removal/replacement of protected sidebar items, suppression of required first-party events, replacement of the Space’s conversation/runtime behaviour, bypass of permissions, mutation of protected first-party graph internals, disabling required recovery/safety behaviour or creation of unbounded loops.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Built-in Space Events & Extensions editor
requirements.text: After a 9to1 update, incompatible/retired hooks MUST produce a needs-attention/repair state rather than silently breaking the whole Space.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > User-created Space full graph editor
requirements.text: User-created Spaces created through + New Space may use the full Space graph editor.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > User-created Space full graph editor
requirements.text: Their graph may define lifecycle behaviour, conversation routing, source retrieval, model/Agent selection, logic/branching, state, app actions, Generative UI, custom sidebar surfaces and other authorised Space behaviour.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > User-created Space full graph editor
requirements.text: Full graphs MAY use bounded logic nodes such as If, Switch, Filter, Merge, Wait, bounded Loop, variables, compare/transform plus typed AI/runtime nodes such as Prompt model, Choose model, Run Agent, invoke Skill/Plugin/MCP, retrieve/search sources and Generate UI.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > User-created Space full graph editor
requirements.text: Full graphs MUST still obey Home permissions, Dulche runtime limits, package/Agent availability, target-app contracts and loop/budget safeguards.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > User-created Space full graph editor
requirements.text: Custom graph edits MUST use Draft versus Active revision semantics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > User-created Space full graph editor
requirements.text: Prior active revisions SHOULD be rollback-capable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Graph-editor AI bar
requirements.text: Both the built-in Events & Extensions editor and the full user-created Space graph editor MUST host the persistent contextual AI bar.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Graph-editor AI bar
requirements.text: A user MUST be able to request behaviour in natural language such as turning on Do Not Disturb when Study activates or adding a Planner sidebar surface.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Graph-editor AI bar
requirements.text: AI-generated graph changes MUST be presented as valid graph mutations and the assistant SHOULD explain the resulting behaviour in plain language, with relevant nodes highlightable from the explanation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Graph-editor AI bar
requirements.text: If a request would modify protected built-in behaviour, the editor/AI MUST reject that mutation and direct the user toward a user-created Space/full graph instead of attempting an unsafe override.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom sidebar surfaces
requirements.text: Space extension graphs MAY add custom sidebar items without replacing protected built-in items.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom sidebar surfaces
requirements.text: Every custom SidebarItem MUST have stable SidebarItemID, title, icon, order/placement, visibility condition where supported, InterfaceType, interface reference/definition and required permissions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom sidebar surfaces
requirements.text: Supported InterfaceType families MUST include AppSurface, CUI and GenerativeUI.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom sidebar surfaces
requirements.text: Generative sidebar interfaces MAY be Dynamic (regenerated/refreshed from current authorised context) or Persisted (stored definition until explicitly regenerated/edited).

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom sidebar surfaces
requirements.text: Generated UI MUST NOT execute arbitrary code or gain permissions merely because it is displayed.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Long-running work and Action Graph
requirements.text: Long-running requests/tasks MUST expose run status, current objective/step, elapsed state, Subagents/tool activity summaries, blockers, approvals and outputs where applicable, with Pause/Resume/Stop/Open Action Graph controls supported by the underlying run.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Long-running work and Action Graph
requirements.text: Closing/navigating away from Spaces MUST NOT automatically kill a run that was explicitly started with background-capable semantics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Long-running work and Action Graph
requirements.text: Home/Dulche retains durable run state and may notify through Home when work completes, blocks, needs approval or fails.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Long-running work and Action Graph
requirements.text: Tool/action rendering may be collapsed in conversation but MUST remain inspectable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Long-running work and Action Graph
requirements.text: Action Graph opens the actual Dulche execution graph; Spaces MUST NOT fabricate a second independent action history.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Agents and Subagents
requirements.text: Persistent Agents may be invoked inside any Space where available/authorised.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Agents and Subagents
requirements.text: The Space contributes authorised context but MUST NOT expand the Agent’s own effective permissions, tool scopes or memory policy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Agents and Subagents
requirements.text: Dulche Subagents remain runtime child-execution primitives and MUST NOT be conflated with persistent user-facing Agents.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Agents and Subagents
requirements.text: Spaces may show concise worker counts/status while detailed execution remains inspectable in Action Graph.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Memory and Dulche Den
requirements.text: Spaces MUST support explicit memory/context scopes including conversation-local, Space-level and permitted broader personal/team/organisation scopes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Memory and Dulche Den
requirements.text: Shared Spaces MUST NOT implicitly expose a participant’s private personal Den context or private connected accounts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Web access and source provenance
requirements.text: Web access MUST be an explicit Space/tool policy with at least Allowed, Ask and Disabled semantics where applicable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Web access and source provenance
requirements.text: Source-only/closed-corpus workflows MUST be able to disable outside web retrieval completely.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Web access and source provenance
requirements.text: When an answer materially relies on identifiable source material, Spaces MUST preserve clickable provenance/citations back to the underlying file/page/message/web source/entity where supported.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Web access and source provenance
requirements.text: It MUST distinguish source-derived claims from generated reasoning and must not claim support that the retrieved sources do not provide.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Search, organisation and sharing
requirements.text: Spaces MUST support search across authorised Space/conversation titles, messages, source names and applicable run/tool metadata.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Search, organisation and sharing
requirements.text: Conversations MUST support rename, pin, archive, delete/recover, move to another compatible Space, duplicate/fork and export.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Search, organisation and sharing
requirements.text: Moving a conversation changes future Space environment/policy but MUST preserve historical provenance/model/action records.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Search, organisation and sharing
requirements.text: Spaces MAY be shared at Space or conversation level with explicit roles such as Viewer, Participant and Editor/Admin or equivalent typed scopes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Search, organisation and sharing
requirements.text: Multi-human conversations MUST record AuthorPrincipalID per human message.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Search, organisation and sharing
requirements.text: Sharing a Space MUST NOT automatically share private external-account credentials or personal Den state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Study structured state
requirements.text: Study MUST persist structured learning state such as course/topic/concept, attempts, recorded confidence/proficiency evidence, last reviewed, next review and source references.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Study structured state
requirements.text: It MUST support source-only versus broader-information policy and clearly distinguish supplied-source content from outside knowledge when both are permitted.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks structured state
requirements.text: Task MUST contain at least TaskID, Objective, Status, Plan, ordered Steps, CurrentStep, Dependencies, Inputs, Outputs, Blockers, Approvals and associated RunID(s).

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks structured state
requirements.text: A Task may invoke persistent Agents, Dulche Subagents and tools, and may itself be launched by an Automation, but Task identity remains the user-level work item rather than becoming an Agent or Automation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Spaces API
requirements.text: Every user-visible Space operation, built-in extension action and full custom graph action MUST have equivalent typed APIs under the global API-parity rule.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Failure behaviour
requirements.text: Spaces MUST return structured failures including SpaceNotFound, ConversationNotFound, MessageNotFound, ContextUnavailable, ContextRevisionConflict, SourceIngestionFailed, PermissionDenied, ModelUnavailable, ModelCapabilityMismatch, ToolUnavailable, ToolFailed, ArtifactUnavailable, ArtifactRevisionConflict, RunBlocked, RunCancelled, RunFailed, WebAccessDisabled, MemoryScopeDenied, SharedContextUnavailable, ProtectedSpaceMutationDenied, InvalidGraphConnection, GraphValidationFailed and ExtensionHookIncompatible in addition to the global error contract.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Acceptance requirements
requirements.text: Chat, Study, Tasks, Assistants, Shopping, Research, Translate and Experiences are distinct protected first-party Space types; other expressly required core Spaces remain in scope.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Acceptance requirements
requirements.text: Built-in Spaces expose only the protected Events & Extensions graph and cannot remove/replace required first-party behaviour/UI.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants And Specialists
requirements.text: Specialist creation, discovery and configuration belong principally to HOME and other owner interfaces, especially AI STUDIO's Specialist Builder; the Chat list may link there.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Chat Groups
requirements.text: Context retrieval must be traceable and not indiscriminate full-history stuffing.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Chat Groups
requirements.text: PROJECT → GROUP NOT SUPPORTED, because of Project-only features/settings, and APIs must reject downgrades.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Chat Groups
requirements.text: Container removal must not silently delete member chats.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Chat Type And Location Dropdown
requirements.text: Message provenance and permission scopes must be maintained.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Professional Chat, Composer, Tools And Request Work
requirements.text: It must reuse the canonical Home-owned searchable @ resources/invocation model and stable identity-backed chips; example screenshot has an invoked Chrome chip.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Professional Chat, Composer, Tools And Request Work
requirements.text: Resource/permission scope must be real, not invisible tokens.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Professional Chat, Composer, Tools And Request Work
requirements.text: Work progress may show real elapsed time, steps, an inline quick question/choice, recorded answer, real output. “Resolve Issues” represents genuine actionable errors, not an always-on warning.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Chat Voice Mode = Floating Pill Over Canonical Voice & Vision
requirements.text: Optional explicit “Open in Voice & Vision” may show full app and preserve SAME session.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Chat Voice Mode = Floating Pill Over Canonical Voice & Vision
requirements.text: Stop sharing must stop frames reaching runtime; model capability and local/cloud constraints respected; proper keyboard/touch access, focus, responsive/motion fallback and genuine failure/recovery states.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Floating Summary And Optional Tabs
requirements.text: SUMMARY is a TOGGLEABLE FLOATING WIDGET ANCHORED AT TOP RIGHT of Spaces workspace, NOT a permanent fourth sidebar or column and MUST NOT shrink the conversation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Floating Summary And Optional Tabs
requirements.text: Widget scopes to the current Space/conversation/run, scrolls within viewport bounds, follows CUI theme and avoids covering required controls.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Floating Summary And Optional Tabs
requirements.text: Other run/task context actions must still allow graph access.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Floating Summary And Optional Tabs
requirements.text: Add optional TAB VIEW entry button in Spaces, with horizontal tabs containing genuine separate conversations, real Haven pages (proper browser engine/history/profile), other real first-party embedded CUI apps, artifacts/images, and safe generated UI when appropriate.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Floating Summary And Optional Tabs
requirements.text: Temporary Chat entry is the chat type selector; its current-session display/close/save/retention behaviours must respect Temporary privacy and storage policies.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Acceptance
requirements.text: Acceptance must check: Professional vs Glow theme separation; rail/Manage Spaces and sidebar customisation/collapse; Assistants as Space with complete persistent functionality; owned Specialist launch; Group/Project features + one-way conversion; chat types, locations and conversions; genuine @ picker/chips + answered quick question; Voice pill using live full Voice & Vision APIs (including screen/camera control); Summary truly floating with correct data; Tab View hosting actual Haven and other 9to1 apps; state recovery, permissions, responsive/keyboard/touch/reduced-motion and real failures.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: DEFAULT for new users MUST be 'Task Space Only'.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: Opening a linked external task must resolve the SAME canonical TaskID, events, checkpoints, active workers, permissions and outputs, and preserve its originating context.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: The filter MUST NOT suspend hidden tasks or hide independently important user notifications/approval requests.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: Current activity must be intelligible without opening the entire dashboard.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: Preserve Spaces sidebar customisation, collapse and extension precedence; required task destinations must remain discoverable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: A Task row should open the canonical task detail/dashboard, not recreate the Task.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: A completed-but-unverified Task must not display the VERIFIED gold tick.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: The details must derive from canonical run/task events, not model-generated fabricated progress or canned explanations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: A tooltip should remain concise and make detailed dashboard evidence available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: Responses must be securely associated with the correct TaskID/RunID/pending request, shown as RECEIVED versus APPLIED when not immediately consumed, delivered to the responsible agent at the next safe boundary, persisted/audited appropriately and reflected across widget/dashboard/chat views.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: Likewise a real pending permission request must be actionable via the task tile/pop-out: the user can REVIEW the specific request and grant/deny only within the existing canonical Home/Dulche typed approval and permission boundaries.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: Never implement a parallel permission broker or let a decorative one-click badge bypass required consent or authentication.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: A task may continue independent authorised work while awaiting one question or approval; the quick-action indicator and underlying execution status remain independently truthful.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: New actionable questions/permissions must remain discoverable even when a higher-priority primary status badge is visible.

requirements.group_title: TASK ORDER, PRIORITY AND SIDEBAR CUSTOMISATION
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: Sorting must use actual canonical priority/active state where supplied, without inventing priorities or deriving urgency from message recency.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: MANDATORY REAL-RUNTIME CHECKS before claiming UI acceptance:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Tasks Space
requirements.text: Inject a real permission request, inspect/deny/grant through canonical provider-controlled approval UI; observe required auth/permission scope and whether unrelated work continues.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: Main retains its canonical ConversationID, Assistant identity, eligible history and authorised context across application navigation/restarts; creating or switching other chats must not silently recreate, replace, erase or split Main.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: The Assistant may have multiple ADDITIONAL conversations with their own titles, histories, current work/context and canonical ConversationIDs, used to organise projects and specialised topics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: Workers must apply changed instructions at safe boundaries.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: Users may ask a Team to accomplish an outcome, and different members can undertake different roles and Tasks (e.g. a future job split by speciality), coordinated through the existing durable Tasks/Run and Automation/Planner services.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: Team settings MUST provide a user-selectable coordination mode with BOTH alternatives:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: Dulche decides which Team Assistants should participate and respond in any particular request based on relevant role/expertise, actual eligibility and permissions, necessary dependencies and task context.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: Example: requesting a video should ordinarily engage the video-relevant Assistant, NOT a Programmer unless programming becomes useful for that request.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: An Assistant omitted from the current discussion may continue independently authorised earlier work; absence of its chat reply does not stop existing work.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: Model-routing decisions, authorised handoffs and resulting worker actions must remain inspectable with correct provenance rather than fabricated participation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: Several relevant members may respond, but Dulche should avoid repeated, low-value status chatter.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: The Team UI may include compact real task/activity summaries without replacing message identities.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: • All — show all eligible Assistant-to-Assistant conversational messages in the Team chat, including routine exchanges where represented as actual conversation messages. • Relevant — show Assistant-to-Assistant conversation that makes meaningful contributions, deliberates decisions, resolves dependencies or materially affects the Team's current work, while routine coordination may remain in the inspectable canonical Tasks/Action Graph/activity history. • None — omit Assistant-to-Assistant conversational exchanges from the normal Team chat display; retain user-directed, individually attributed Assistant messages, significant user-facing requests/approvals and independently inspectable task/action evidence.

requirements.group_title: ROLES, SHARED WORK, CONTEXT, SECURITY AND OWNER SERVICES
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: Assistants retain the V2 persistent identity, independent Main/organised conversations, full capability/configuration parity, memory and context policy, direct chats, optional Mini Computer, proactivity, project access and Tools/Plugins/Skills.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: Its contextual sidebar/workspace MUST make it natural to reach an Assistant's Main and other chats as well as permanent Teams.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Assistants Space and Teams
requirements.text: Real-runtime acceptance must verify, with actual Assistant and Team objects and canonical IDs:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: Plan generation must not be misrepresented as final research output.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: The workspace's primary sections are Conversation, Sources, Plan, Findings and Report; conversation may be presented as a clickable conversation tile, and selecting that tile opens the full normal conversation view, retaining its ConversationID/history/drafts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: Outputs/Artefacts may also be exposed where relevant and permitted.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: MANDATORY REVIEW AND RESEARCH-TYPE SELECTION

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: Either output choice is available in any applicable research type, subject to genuine capabilities and permissions; especially for Custom, Research may solve a substantive technical problem through research, implementation and testing rather than merely writing prose.

requirements.group_title: ACTIVE EXECUTION TIME, NOT WALL-CLOCK TIME
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: The UI MUST NOT equate time used with percent of objective completed.

requirements.group_title: UNIVERSAL SPACES STEER / QUEUE WITH PER-SPACE DEFAULT
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: A USER-CONFIGURABLE PREFERRED SEND ACTION MUST exist INDEPENDENTLY FOR EACH SPACE.

requirements.group_title: ALT+ENTER INVERTS THE CURRENT SPACE'S SEND ACTION
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: It must NOT change or reset the stored preference.

requirements.group_title: ALT+ENTER INVERTS THE CURRENT SPACE'S SEND ACTION
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: A user-selected one-off action in the composer should remain plainly distinguishable from changing the durable default.

requirements.group_title: ALT+ENTER INVERTS THE CURRENT SPACE'S SEND ACTION
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: If a platform/IME reserves or intercepts the chord, the UI must expose a working equivalent and report compatibility truthfully rather than pretending the shortcut executed.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: MANDATORY ACTUAL-RUNTIME RESEARCH TESTS: new Research -> normal chat; submit initial request -> Plan auto-selected and generated; review/edit plan; choose each of four modes, custom maximum 28 active days and invalid input validation; choose either output mode; Start genuine authorised Task/Run; inspect real sources, plan, findings, report/artefacts; click conversation tile to open SAME chat; send further information with floating composer; preserve state through reload, model fallback, crash, pause and permissions; confirm source provenance, typed output APIs and honest missing/bad evidence.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: MANDATORY SHARED SPACES TESTS: configure Steer in one Space and Queue in another; confirm the per-Space preference persists separately and normal send applies it during a live task/response; Alt+Enter inverts only this SEND; verify switched Space retains its own default; verify received versus applied for steering, FIFO/ordered queue consumption/cancellation/recovery for queued instructions, no duplicate side effects or unauthorized permission escalation; exercise non-running conversation, focused multi-line/IME, Shift+Enter, shortcut accessibility and native/browser differences.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Research Space and shared send behaviour
requirements.text: Cross-app Task widget/dashboard and response provenance must remain consistent.

requirements.group_title: SHOPPING SPACE: CHAT TO SHOPPING WORKSPACE
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: The exact placement of optional full-conversation access, side panels, visual proportions and navigation subsections remains subject to CUI review.

requirements.group_title: CONVENTIONAL SHOPPING FILTERS PLUS NATURAL-LANGUAGE CONTROL
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: The Shopping workspace MUST expose working search/filter/sort controls appropriate to actual products, including PRICE RANGE, FILTERABLE FEATURES/SPECIFICATIONS, DELIVERY TIME, SHIPPING COST, BRAND and other category-relevant attributes (e.g. colour, platform, edition, condition, seller/availability where applicable).

requirements.group_title: CONVENTIONAL SHOPPING FILTERS PLUS NATURAL-LANGUAGE CONTROL
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Visible filters, chips, counts, search results and comparison views must reflect the effective currently accepted state, including clarifying or correcting ambiguous inferred requirements.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: REQUIRED VERSUS PREFERRED CONSTRAINTS

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Every applicable user search criterion/filter can be explicitly marked REQUIRED or PREFERRED, with effective semantics visible and user-editable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: The user can declare them in a prompt or select/change them directly in the filter interface; the assistant can interpret natural language, but must not silently harden a preference into a mandatory criterion, or overlook an explicit hard constraint.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Examples: “black hairdryer under £100, preferably next-day delivery” means black + price cap REQUIRED and next-day delivery PREFERRED unless the user revises them.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: A product satisfying all VERIFIED/KNOWN REQUIRED conditions may be a DIRECT RESULT even if it lacks a preferred property; preferred matches influence ranking/explanations rather than mandatory eligibility.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Changing Required/Preferred must immediately and honestly recompute categorisation, rankings, match explanations and where relevant product/offer counts from actual data.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: DIRECT RESULTS: products whose documented, currently supported attributes meet all current REQUIRED constraints, whether or not every PREFERRED feature is present.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: The product must be real and its claimed specifications, delivery and offer data grounded; do not pad this tab with unverified supposedly exact matches.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: SIMILAR RESULTS: relevant alternatives meeting some, but not all, required criteria, with clear per-product disclosure of the specific missing/mismatched REQUIRED properties, unknown fields, and useful matching features.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: If black is only Preferred, the same blue hairdryer may qualify as Direct, with its preference shortfall explained.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Example: after previous discussion of a broken fridge, smart-fridge results may be contextually relevant when currently shopping for smart toasters; unrelated gloves/shoes must NOT surface merely because they were also mentioned historically.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Other must not masquerade as fulfilment of required search constraints, exploit sensitive context, or expose unauthorised memories.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Keep the explanation for why a related suggestion appeared inspectable and provide appropriate normal memory/personalisation controls under existing Home/Dulche policy. “Other” is a relevance-gated discovery surface, not indiscriminate advertising, and must still meet source-truthfulness rules.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: All three tabs use actual product records and user/session requirements; switching tabs must not reset filters or lose the conversation.

requirements.group_title: PHYSICAL, DIGITAL, APPS, GAMES AND NONTRADITIONAL SHOPPING
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Shopping MUST support BOTH physical and digital goods when relevant to the user's intent.

requirements.group_title: PHYSICAL, DIGITAL, APPS, GAMES AND NONTRADITIONAL SHOPPING
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Product discovery, comparisons, saved items, price/rating/offer views, filters and results categories must work for DIGITAL PRODUCTS, SOFTWARE/APPLICATIONS and GAMES as first-class shopping categories; do not restrict results to physical items, hardware or traditional shopping.

requirements.group_title: PHYSICAL, DIGITAL, APPS, GAMES AND NONTRADITIONAL SHOPPING
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Category-aware filters should surface grounded relevant metadata as applicable, such as supported operating system/device/platform, version or edition, licence/subscription/one-time purchase model, access/delivery/activation method, digital ownership or entitlement scope, regional restrictions, interoperability/compatibility, seller/storefront, update/support information and bundled extras or downloadable content where genuinely supported.

requirements.group_title: PHYSICAL, DIGITAL, APPS, GAMES AND NONTRADITIONAL SHOPPING
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Shipping, shipping cost and physical delivery filters must adapt sensibly to DIGITAL listings; show Not Applicable or digital fulfilment/activation timing as appropriate, NEVER fictional shipping charges or physical delivery promises.

requirements.group_title: PHYSICAL, DIGITAL, APPS, GAMES AND NONTRADITIONAL SHOPPING
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: The same required-versus-preferred matching logic applies across physical and digital listings.

requirements.group_title: PRODUCTS VERSUS MERCHANT OFFERS; CONTEXTUAL COMPARISON AND INTEGRATION
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: The UI must avoid conflating two distinct editions, digital licences or physical variants merely because titles look similar.

requirements.group_title: PRODUCTS VERSUS MERCHANT OFFERS; CONTEXTUAL COMPARISON AND INTEGRATION
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Shopping may call authorised Research, Haven, Files, Home, Assistants and Automations/Tasks typed APIs where appropriate but does not create an independent provider of files, app ownership, payments, task state, prices or permissions.

requirements.group_title: PRODUCTS VERSUS MERCHANT OFFERS; CONTEXTUAL COMPARISON AND INTEGRATION
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Optional price watches should use actual available price history/telemetry and canonical Automations rather than invented changes or another scheduler.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Shopping Space
requirements.text: Required and Preferred classification is visible, editable and respected: hard mismatch goes to Similar, preference mismatch may remain Direct; unknown mandatory attribute never becomes falsely verified.

requirements.group_title: SINGLE CANONICAL SPACE, THREE FREELY SWITCHABLE BUILDER TABS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: The full Custom Space Creator/Builder MUST expose three peer-level tabs labeled EXACTLY “Basic” | “Advanced” | “Expert”.

requirements.group_title: SINGLE CANONICAL SPACE, THREE FREELY SWITCHABLE BUILDER TABS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: Switching MUST NOT drop, overwrite, flatten, disable or regenerate logic configured in another tier.

requirements.group_title: SINGLE CANONICAL SPACE, THREE FREELY SWITCHABLE BUILDER TABS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: Basic/Advanced modify only the settings that those views expose, preserving Expert-only nodes and connections; a conflict between a simplified control and a more complex Expert graph must be previewed and explicitly resolved instead of silently choosing a winner or deleting nodes.

requirements.group_title: SINGLE CANONICAL SPACE, THREE FREELY SWITCHABLE BUILDER TABS
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: The indicator links to relevant Expert sections and must not be treated as a reason to lock or hide Basic/Advanced.

requirements.group_title: BASIC TAB: BORDERLESS SINGLE-SCREEN DOCUMENT CONFIGURATION
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: Basic creation should remain easy for an ordinary nontechnical user, without mandatory Expert graph work.

requirements.group_title: ADVANCED TAB: SAME DOCUMENT, FULL POLICY/FEATURE DETAIL
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: Advanced uses the SAME single-screen borderless document-style editor, revealing optional expanded sections/controls without switching to a disjoint multi-page settings dashboard.

requirements.group_title: ADVANCED TAB: SAME DOCUMENT, FULL POLICY/FEATURE DETAIL
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: Include Name, Description, Icon, editable Custom Instructions and MANDATORY SKILLS; independently Allowed / Blocked / Inherited scopes for specific Skills, Plugins, Apps and Models, plus an On/Off gate for each whole category; attached FILES including Skills/Plugins.

requirements.group_title: ADVANCED TAB: SAME DOCUMENT, FULL POLICY/FEATURE DETAIL
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: Advanced must also contain:

requirements.group_title: ADVANCED TAB: SAME DOCUMENT, FULL POLICY/FEATURE DETAIL
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: • MEMORY SETTINGS (memory enabled/state, scope, policy, eligible personal/Space/team context and authorised source retrieval; correct Dulche Den/UCML broker boundaries); • optional RESPONSE/MODEL overrides such as temperature, effective context window where supported, eligible reasoning parameters, model route, and other genuinely advertised settings; enforce real model/provider capabilities and account/security limits; • ASSISTANT/SPECIALIST SETTINGS: enable/disable those categories, select eligible default configured identities and relevant routing/mention policies without cloning/redefining them or bypassing access control; • AUTOMATIONS bound to the Space, including appropriately authorised auto-run/scheduled triggers, slash-command launch and contextual sidebar action/item launch through the existing canonical Automations owner; no competing scheduler or store; • optional Space-specific overrides of THEME, SIDEBAR CONFIG and UNDER-MESSAGE CONTROLS, using shared CUI/Home preference inheritance with reversible, inspectable precedence; • SUGGESTED PROMPTS / starter suggestions tied to genuine saved Space configuration, without untrusted text execution.

requirements.group_title: ADVANCED TAB: SAME DOCUMENT, FULL POLICY/FEATURE DETAIL
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: Controls must be real saved settings that correctly map to the Expert view or declarative projections.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: Each page must retain appropriate context, unsaved/draft state, working selection, scroll/pan/zoom, accessible navigation, real CUI theme and canonical IDs when switching.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
requirements.text: As per existing V2, graph editor must support contextual AI assistance that performs real typed graph edits, rather than an inert “generate” UI or pointer-simulated editing.

requirements.group_title: EXPERT USES THE EXISTING 9TO1 AUTOMATIONS NODE SYSTEM
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Spaces and Space Builder > Custom Space Builder
