requirements.text: Breadcrumbs MUST distinguish a contextual section/group from an actual filesystem folder, and Show original location MUST resolve the canonical storage location.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F02 — Folder
requirements.text: The new organisation types MUST NOT reinterpret existing folders, add mandatory grouping metadata or replace normal move/copy semantics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F02 — Folder
requirements.text: Folder acceptance MUST verify ordinary create, rename, move, copy, delete/restore, colour, sort and nested navigation before and after adding organisation objects.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F02 — Folder
requirements.text: A normal folder opened from a Project, Tree or Matrix MUST still behave as a folder, and returning to the parent context MUST restore that view without moving the folder.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F03 — Project
requirements.text: Sections are not subfolders and assigning an item to a section MUST NOT change its underlying Files location.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F03 — Project
requirements.text: The main view MUST show each section's title, authorised item count, collapse control, contextual menu and Add item entry point.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F03 — Project
requirements.text: Removing a section MUST offer to keep its members in Unsectioned or remove those appearances; neither option deletes originals.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F03 — Project
requirements.text: Sorting items within one section MUST not reorder the other sections unless the user applies a Project-wide sort.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F03 — Project
requirements.text: Per-user collapse state MUST not rewrite shared ordering.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F03 — Project
requirements.text: Project acceptance MUST create the Homework example, add a nested folder and another organisation type, reorder and rename sections, follow a SectionID link after rename, move an appearance and delete a section while retaining originals.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F03 — Project
requirements.text: Reopen and a second authorised client MUST preserve authored section order/membership; viewer mode MUST allow reading and navigation without showing usable mutation controls.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F04 — Sheet
requirements.text: The canvas MUST support file/folder/organisation appearances, sticky notes, rich text, images, labelled connections, freehand drawing and shapes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F04 — Sheet
requirements.text: The editor MUST provide Select, Pan, Add files, Text, Sticky note, Image, Shape, Pen, Eraser and Connector tools.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F04 — Sheet
requirements.text: Snap/grid controls, zoom, fit and an object outline MUST be available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F04 — Sheet
requirements.text: File appearances MUST show a useful permission-safe name/type/preview and an identifiable open action.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F04 — Sheet
requirements.text: Pop-up editing uses only a safe registered owning editor and MUST identify that it changes the original; otherwise provide a read-only preview and Open in owning app.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F04 — Sheet
requirements.text: Moving or deleting a file appearance MUST not alter an unrelated appearance in another Sheet, while editing the canonical file MUST update every authorised live reference.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F04 — Sheet
requirements.text: Undo for local geometry MUST not roll back source edits performed through a different editor.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F04 — Sheet
requirements.text: Sheet acceptance MUST combine a Write file, image, sticky note, labelled connection, freehand stroke, shape and nested Stash; arrange and group them; open and edit the same original from two contexts; close the preview and recover the prior canvas position; switch opening policy; and save/reopen with identical authored layout.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F04 — Sheet
requirements.text: Keyboard and touch users MUST be able to create, select, open and reposition items without precise pointer dragging.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F05 — Tree
requirements.text: Editors MUST see a Tree / View switch.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F05 — Tree
requirements.text: Connections, parent/group relationships and collapsed branches MUST be explicit.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F05 — Tree
requirements.text: Reparenting MUST preview its structural effect; a cycle is rejected.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F05 — Tree
requirements.text: Changing arrangement MUST not change logical relationships or file identity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F05 — Tree
requirements.text: View-only users MUST receive View, not a disabled visual Tree.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F05 — Tree
requirements.text: They can open authorised groups/files and navigate Back, but MUST NOT obtain the protected visual layout through a hidden route, embed or layout API.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F05 — Tree
requirements.text: Removing a group or node MUST show whether children are being retained/reassigned or appearances removed and MUST never delete originals as an incidental graph operation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F05 — Tree
requirements.text: Tree acceptance MUST verify the Maths journey, one file in two Trees, rename/move stability, cycle rejection, editor/viewer mode differences, nested folders and no protected-layout leakage through APIs or Boards embeds.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F06 — Smart
requirements.text: The editor MUST show a readable rule builder, location/scope picker, All/Any condition grouping, supported operators and a live result preview.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F06 — Smart
requirements.text: Values that are unavailable MUST be treated as unknown, not silently replaced with false, zero or an empty string.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F06 — Smart
requirements.text: Removing a dynamically matched appearance MUST explain that it will return while it matches and direct the user to adjust the rule or scope rather than pretending the source was removed from the collection.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F06 — Smart
requirements.text: It MUST not run an opaque classifier as the only explanation for membership or search private locations without permission.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F06 — Smart
requirements.text: A disconnected provider MUST NOT make its missing results look like confirmed non-matches.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F06 — Smart
requirements.text: Smart acceptance MUST demonstrate entry/exit after tag and date changes, All/Any conditions, a pinned non-match, a newly inaccessible location, an offline result set and an inspectable AI-generated rule proposal.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F06 — Smart
requirements.text: No match operation may move, duplicate or widen access to an original.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F07 — Timeline
requirements.text: The main surface MUST provide a labelled time axis, zoom between broad periods and individual dates, pan, date navigation, fit, an Undated area and a visible Date source selector: Created, Modified, Deadline or Assigned.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F07 — Timeline
requirements.text: The inspector MUST show the effective date/range, source of that value, relevant timezone/date-only interpretation and any locally assigned value.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F07 — Timeline
requirements.text: Under Created/Modified/Deadline, the UI MUST explain the source rather than secretly rewrite it; explicitly editing a writable source date invokes its owning operation with permission and impact checks.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F07 — Timeline
requirements.text: Overlapping items MUST remain discoverable through stacking/grouping, previews and the folder-style alternative.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F07 — Timeline
requirements.text: Changing the selected date source MUST preserve authored assigned dates and periods for later reuse instead of deleting them.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F07 — Timeline
requirements.text: Timeline acceptance MUST cover all four date-source choices, an ongoing range, an undated file, overlapping files, a nested organisation, a period pop-up, timezone/date-only boundaries and a source modification that updates the view without rewriting unrelated dates.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F08 — Pipeline
requirements.text: The main view MUST show horizontally arranged stage columns, accessible stage titles/counts, item previews, Add stage and Add item.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F08 — Pipeline
requirements.text: The stage editor MUST support optional checklist requirements and reviewer approval.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F08 — Pipeline
requirements.text: Reviewer identity and authority MUST be checked.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F08 — Pipeline
requirements.text: A Mapping control may explicitly connect a selected field/stage to global file metadata, showing the target field, conversion, affected items, required rights and conflict behaviour before activation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F08 — Pipeline
requirements.text: If the global update cannot be authorised or committed, the transition remains blocked or reports an explicitly declared partial result; it MUST not silently claim both succeeded.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F08 — Pipeline
requirements.text: Deleting a stage MUST require a destination for retained entries or explicit removal of appearances.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F08 — Pipeline
requirements.text: Pipeline acceptance MUST move an item by pointer, keyboard and API; reject an unmet checklist; obtain and revoke an authorised approval; handle a simultaneous transition; and prove that a stage change in one Pipeline does not change another Pipeline or source metadata without an explicit mapping.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F09 — Catalogue
requirements.text: It MUST provide Cards, Table and Grouped views, a field editor, sort/filter/group controls and an information panel that opens without launching the full source document.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F09 — Catalogue
requirements.text: The file itself is the organised item; typing a filename into a disconnected table cell MUST NOT create a valid source reference.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F09 — Catalogue
requirements.text: The UI MUST distinguish source metadata from Catalogue-local fields, and read-only source values from writable ones.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F09 — Catalogue
requirements.text: Editing local notes or ratings MUST not alter another Catalogue.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F09 — Catalogue
requirements.text: Changing a field type MUST preview incompatible values and preserve them until an explicit conversion is confirmed.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F09 — Catalogue
requirements.text: The entry panel MUST show the authorised source identity/location, available metadata, local values, Open, Show original location and Remove from Catalogue.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F09 — Catalogue
requirements.text: Catalogue acceptance MUST use the same file in two Catalogues with different local notes, change a true global property visibly, reject an invalid field value, preserve values during type changes, open the information panel in all views and retain canonical identity after source rename.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F10 — Stash
requirements.text: Its reader MUST show the current item, its position in the sequence, Previous/Next, an overview/filmstrip, Open in owning app and an optional Reviewed control.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F10 — Stash
requirements.text: Keyboard and touch navigation MUST work.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F10 — Stash
requirements.text: A Compare action opens two selected entries side by side with independent source identity and navigation; changing one comparison slot MUST not silently advance the main reading position.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F10 — Stash
requirements.text: On narrow screens comparison may switch between clearly labelled A/B views while retaining both selected entries.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F10 — Stash
requirements.text: Reading position and optional reviewed state are per user, keyed to EntryID rather than numeric position, and survive restart.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F10 — Stash
requirements.text: Reordering MUST retain the reader's current item when it still exists.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F10 — Stash
requirements.text: The UI MUST distinguish Complete/reviewed status from actually changing a file's global work status.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F10 — Stash
requirements.text: Stash acceptance MUST save a non-alphabetical sequence, reopen at the same item, mark reviewed items, reorder from another authorised client, compare two files, handle a denied/missing source and return from a Sheet pop-up without changing the canvas or cloning files.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F11 — Matrix
requirements.text: The main view MUST display user-defined row and column headings together, with sticky headings or an equivalent persistent orientation aid, cell counts/previews, Add row, Add column and view/zoom controls.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F11 — Matrix
requirements.text: Keyboard navigation MUST identify the current row/column and provide explicit move/add/open commands.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F11 — Matrix
requirements.text: Large grids MUST remain navigable using filtering, scrolling and the normal contents view rather than shrinking every cell until its contents are unreadable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F11 — Matrix
requirements.text: Removing an axis previews the affected memberships and offers reassignment, retention in an Unassigned group or removal of appearances; it MUST not delete originals.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F11 — Matrix
requirements.text: A row/column combined view MUST not suggest that repeated appearances are independent copies: repeated canonical items are coalesced with visible placement context or clearly marked as repeated references.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F11 — Matrix
requirements.text: The authorised counts MUST correspond to the chosen displayed unit, not include hidden private entries.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Files > TF-F11 — Matrix
requirements.text: Matrix acceptance MUST build Topic A/B/C rows and Writing/Data/Presentations columns, populate a cell with a nested folder, open cell/row/column groups, rename/reorder both axes, move an appearance, remove an axis safely and reopen without losing identity, classification or readable orientation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > CAKE ID and authentication
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: CAKE ID is the shared identity used across CAKE and 9to1. A normal CAKE ID is separate from a WordPress user account; WordPress may remain linked for site administration, but ordinary 9to1 users must not need WordPress accounts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > CAKE ID and authentication
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Authentication/session operations must support account sign-in/sign-out, current-user/profile lookup, active-session/device inspection and revocation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > 9to1 welcome and first-run flow
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: A fresh 9to1 desktop/Home profile MUST use a short, skippable welcome flow before normal Home use.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > 9to1 welcome and first-run flow
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: This flow is separate from the fuller 9to1-OS installer/OOBE contract and MUST NOT require a CAKE ID or local-model download in order to reach local 9to1 functionality.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Step 1 — Welcome
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The first screen SHOULD remain deliberately minimal and MUST NOT present an unrelated setup questionnaire.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Step 2 — Sign In?
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Successful authentication MUST return the resulting authorised session to the initiating 9to1 profile without exposing provider secrets to the client.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Step 3 — Local model discovery
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: After the sign-in decision, 9to1 MUST search the supported local-model/runtime registry for an installed model that satisfies the current minimum local-AI capability policy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Step 3 — Local model discovery
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The screen presents up to three currently recommended models as selectable model cards and shows inline download progress for active downloads.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Step 3 — Local model discovery
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The user MAY continue without downloading a model.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Step 3 — Local model discovery
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The recommended-model list MUST NOT be hard-coded into the shipped client. 9to1 MUST retrieve a small versioned recommendation manifest hosted under 9to1.uk.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Step 3 — Local model discovery
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Each recommendation identifies the intended model/source and Hugging Face download location plus the metadata required by the existing Dulche local-model verification/install path.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Step 3 — Local model discovery
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: This allows the recommended set to change without requiring a 9to1 client update.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Step 3 — Local model discovery
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Failure to retrieve the manifest MUST degrade to an honest unavailable state rather than fabricate recommendations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Completion and repeat behaviour
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: After the sign-in/model decisions are complete or skipped, continue directly into Home; no additional mandatory completion page is required.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Completion and repeat behaviour
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The completion state MUST persist for that profile so ordinary returning users are not shown the welcome flow again.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profiles — customisation and Jacob's reserved account
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Profile customisation MUST include changing the display name and username through the profile/account UI and equivalent authorised APIs.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profiles — customisation and Jacob's reserved account
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Username availability, uniqueness and reservation checks MUST apply consistently across UI, APIs, registration and rename flows.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profiles — customisation and Jacob's reserved account
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Changes MUST preserve the canonical CAKE ID/UserID, ownership, history, permissions and entitlements; mutable names MUST NOT become identity or authorisation keys.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profiles — customisation and Jacob's reserved account
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The exact handle @CroakyJake MUST be reserved exclusively for Jacob.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profiles — customisation and Jacob's reserved account
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Registration and rename flows MUST prevent other accounts from claiming it, including case variants that would bypass the reservation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profiles — customisation and Jacob's reserved account
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The reservation MUST be bound through trusted provisioning to Jacob's verified canonical account ID, not awarded to whichever account first requests that text.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profiles — customisation and Jacob's reserved account
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Production identifiers MUST be verified rather than guessed.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profiles — customisation and Jacob's reserved account
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Jacob's verified account MUST automatically receive all Business features free of charge, including subsequently added Business features, without requiring a paid Business subscription.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profiles — customisation and Jacob's reserved account
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: This is an account-bound entitlement: changing a display name or username MUST NOT grant it to another person or remove it from Jacob.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profiles — customisation and Jacob's reserved account
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Reservation and entitlement administration MUST be privileged, auditable operations, separate from ordinary profile editing.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The profile editor MUST include the following fields.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: An asterisk (*) denotes a required field; only Name and Username are required within this field set.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Name* — REQUIRED.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Username* — REQUIRED.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Icon — OPTIONAL.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Pronouns — OPTIONAL.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Job — OPTIONAL.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: This field is especially relevant in a Business context but MUST also be available to ordinary personal users; it MUST NOT be Business-only or mandatory for Business users.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The UI MUST visibly mark Name and Username with an asterisk and explain that * denotes required.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Icon, Pronouns and Job MUST be allowed to remain unset and to be cleared without preventing an otherwise valid profile from being saved.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Name and Username MUST NOT be saved as empty or whitespace-only values.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Optional personal information MUST NOT be inferred or populated without the user's input.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The equivalent authorised profile APIs MUST expose the same five fields and apply the same required/optional validation rules.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Partial updates MUST preserve fields omitted from the request rather than clearing them.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile customisation — required and optional fields
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Acceptance MUST verify that a profile can be saved with valid Name and Username while Icon, Pronouns and Job are unset; all three optional fields can subsequently be added, changed and cleared; Job is available to both personal and Business users without becoming required; blank required fields produce validation errors; and equivalent authorised API operations preserve the same behaviour and account identity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile API, provisioning and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Reservation and account-bound Business-entitlement provisioning MUST remain privileged, auditable operations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile API, provisioning and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: APIs MUST expose the same validation as the UI, preserve omitted fields and return structured conflicts or validation failures.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Profile API, provisioning and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Ordinary clients MUST NOT self-grant Business access.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Subscription model
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: 9to1 uses a preset-first subscription model with optional customisation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Subscription model
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The two MUST be stored and evaluated independently.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Subscription model
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: APIs, billing logic and entitlement checks MUST use stable PlanID/PlanLevel rather than inferring ordering from display names.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Subscription model
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: A preset is a convenience starting configuration; the preset label MUST NOT be treated as the sole source of entitlement truth.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Subscription model
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The Free configuration MUST retain useful local/core functionality while cloud AI, hosted storage/sites and other server-funded resources remain subject to server-authoritative entitlements and quotas.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Price thresholds
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The backend MUST compute effective threshold entitlements from this value; clients MUST NOT infer them from the displayed preset name.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Price thresholds
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: If a user customises a preset and the resulting configured price crosses a different threshold, the backend MUST recalculate the effective threshold set from the resulting EntitlementPriceMonthly.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Price thresholds
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Cloud model entitlement MUST be expressed through versioned effective model-cost/capability bands rather than a permanent allow-list of model brand names.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Price thresholds
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Any CAKE-funded model whose effective provider cost and capability profile fit within the user's unlocked band may be made available, subject to provider availability, safety/privacy policy and backend configuration.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Price thresholds
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Replacing a benchmark model with another comparably priced model MUST NOT require renaming the subscription tier.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Price thresholds
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Until that rule is defined, threshold eligibility MUST be calculated only by the server and MUST NOT be reproduced locally by clients.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: A preset MUST define explicit resource values such as allocated AI Dust, storage allocation, hosted-site limits, concurrency/burst limits where applicable and any other metered resources supported by the subscription system.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Preset configuration and threshold entitlement state MUST remain separate server-side fields.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Changing resource values MAY change the configured monthly price and therefore the unlocked threshold set, but MUST NOT mutate the canonical definition of the source preset.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: A customised plan MUST retain the concrete resource values selected by the user even when those values no longer match any named preset.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The UI MAY display the source preset for context, but APIs MUST return the actual resource configuration rather than reconstructing it from a tier name.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Preset definitions MUST be versioned.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Existing accounts MUST retain an auditable reference to the preset version they originally selected plus subsequent customisation state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Updating a preset definition MUST NOT silently rewrite existing subscriber allocations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Pro (£34.99), Ultra (£69.99), Ultra+ (£99.99) and Max (£149.99) MUST each provide materially more included cloud-AI usage, storage and hosted-site capacity than the preceding paid preset.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Exact AI Dust/storage/site quantities above Plus are not yet fully specified and MUST NOT be invented.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations > Canonical subscription state
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The server-authoritative subscription object MUST expose at least the following fields:

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Preset configurations > Canonical subscription state
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Clients MUST ignore unknown keys they do not understand while preserving them when round-tripping configuration.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Free hosted-site inactivity
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: During the first 120 days the account MUST sign in at least once every 30 days to keep the free site online.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Free hosted-site inactivity
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Taking a site offline MUST NOT delete its stored site data.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business add-ons — pricing, seats and resource billing
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Purchased AI usage/credits, storage and other funded resources remain separately configured and may be pooled or allocated individually; unlimited seats do not mean unlimited resources.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business add-ons — pricing, seats and resource billing
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Business + includes the Business capability set; further exclusive Business + capabilities are OPEN and MUST NOT be invented from its name.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business add-ons — pricing, seats and resource billing
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Pricing displays, quotes, invoices and entitlement APIs MUST distinguish the organisation add-on, seat capacity and resource charges.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business add-ons — pricing, seats and resource billing
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: A base-resource quote in another currency MUST NOT be silently relabelled as USD; the trusted billing quote must make currency/conversion explicit.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business add-ons — pricing, seats and resource billing
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Billing state MUST store AddOnID, add-on definition version, OrgID, seat-limit value or explicit Unlimited, effective dates and applicable account-bound grants separately from user resource configurations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business add-ons — pricing, seats and resource billing
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Changing Business + to Business with more than 50 active members MUST require a seat-remediation preview or retain a visibly constrained pending-downgrade state; it must not silently remove users or delete shared content.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business add-ons — pricing, seats and resource billing
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Add-on cancellation and billing failure MUST have explicit entitlement/recovery states.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Entitlements and usage API
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The subscription/account layer must expose supported first-party APIs for the information and actions available to the user, following the global API-parity rule.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Server-authoritative enforcement
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Short-lived or one-time signed capability tokens may be used internally for narrowly scoped operations, but they do not become reusable secrets embedded in applications.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Web subscription behaviour
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Web and desktop clients MUST resolve account state from the same CAKE ID and entitlement service.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Web subscription behaviour
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: For the same account and organisation context, plan identity, Dust balance, hosted-storage usage, site quota/usage and applicable feature entitlements MUST be consistent across official clients, subject only to explicitly documented platform capability differences.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Web subscription behaviour
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Where a future web feature requires material hosted compute that is not available on the free/local product - for example hosted Mini Computer virtual machines - it may be offered as a subscription-backed server capability with explicit resource limits.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Web subscription behaviour
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The browser UI must never pretend that local-only or unavailable server compute exists.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Every organisation-scoped operation MUST carry an explicit OrgID and authenticated membership/delegation context.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Joining an organisation MUST NOT merge personal files, chats, memories, devices or credentials into it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Each organisation MUST support a canonical shared Team Space backed by organisation-owned shared storage, not an independent copy of every member’s files.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The organisation drive MUST support folders, create/upload/open/edit where the owning app supports it, search, move/rename, version history, sharing/access review, archive/delete/recover and authorised export.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Access may be assigned to organisation roles/groups or explicitly scoped members.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: External sharing requires policy permission and explicit recipient/link scope; revocation must remove future server access and invalidate applicable derived access paths.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Shared-storage accounting MUST identify the owning organisation and charge canonical stored data once according to the storage policy rather than once per viewer.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Connect MUST provide an organisation directory and scoped organisational groups/channels and contact endpoints, with role-controlled membership, creation and management.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Organisation communications MUST use Connect’s canonical conversations, contacts, calls and message identities.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Business Mesh MUST allow explicitly authorised devices belonging to different organisation members to share supported compute/storage capabilities through Home/Mesh.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Enrolment records MUST bind DeviceID, device/account owner, OrgID, verified trust/key material reference, supported capabilities, resource limits and grant expiry/revocation state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Organisation membership alone must not automatically pair a personal device or expose its files, GPU or network.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: A resource grant MUST specify permitted consumers/workloads, CPU/GPU/memory/storage/concurrency budgets and permitted data locations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Mesh MUST expose availability, queued/running jobs, utilisation, failure and cancellation/revocation outcomes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Revocation blocks new work and cancels or safely terminates existing work where supported; it must not claim to undo already completed actions or erase copies outside its actual control.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: An organisation MUST be able to use a shared funded AI/resource pool or individually partition its purchased allocation by member/role.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Parallel requests, retries and delayed provider reports MUST NOT spend the same balance twice.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Role-based rollover permission defined in Admin MUST be applied to eligible credit lots at rollover/expiry transitions and be visible in member balances.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The product MUST distinguish rolled-over credits from newly purchased allocation and show the effective expiry.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Eligible members MUST be able to discover and invoke it from supported Spaces/app pickers and configured Connect channels without creating separate private copies.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Agent publishing/versioning, ownership transfer, required Plugins, allowed models, tool scopes, approval boundaries, schedules, budgets and concurrency limits MUST be enforced by Dulche/Home and the owning services.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Pausing, revoking or archiving a team Agent MUST stop new authorised dispatch, preserve auditable run history and report what happened to queued/running work.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Business MUST provide device-level administrative controls for explicitly enrolled managed 9to1-OS Business accounts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Controls MUST cover supported app/package and Plugin installation/enablement restrictions, allowed features and Automations, required organisation/role Plugins, enforced settings, default-model/routing policy and Mesh-resource participation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The OS policy agent MUST verify policy origin/version, apply only the enrolled managed scope and report Applied, Pending, Failed, Unsupported or NonCompliant status with reasons.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Revocation and next-contact reconciliation must be explicit.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Other operating systems may expose supported Mesh and app policy, but they must not claim complete 9to1-OS endpoint-management parity without an explicit capability implementation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Permissions, policy, membership and credit changes MUST propagate through supported authoritative services and invalidate affected cached grants before further protected server actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Downgrade, service outage or partial rollout must preserve data and fail closed for newly unauthorised actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Business features — functional specification
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Acceptance MUST demonstrate a shared artifact edited through two apps without forking; denied access absent from search, preview and AI context; organisation Connect without access to personal messages; explicit two-account Mesh enrolment, bounded execution and revocation; shared-pool concurrency and individual ceilings; role-dependent rollover; a team Agent that cannot leak another member’s private context; and OS restrictions enforced below UI across restart/offline/reconnect.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > External App Integrations
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Authentication, provider scopes, transport, sync, webhooks, rate limits, provider-specific errors and remote-entity identity MUST be encapsulated by this shared layer rather than reimplemented independently inside each consuming app.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Core connection model
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The framework MUST define stable typed entities for IntegrationProvider, Connection, ExternalAccount, IntegrationCapability, CredentialReference, RemoteEntityReference, SyncCursor, WebhookSubscription and ConnectionHealth or equivalent contracts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Core connection model
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Multiple accounts/connections for the same provider MUST be supported.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Core connection model
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: For example, a user may connect separate personal and work Google accounts or multiple GitHub identities without those accounts being merged or ambiguously selected.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Connect once, reuse through authorised capabilities
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: A provider account should be connected once through the integration framework and then reused by authorised 9to1 surfaces.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Connect once, reuse through authorised capabilities
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Consuming apps MUST request capabilities from the existing Connection rather than maintaining private duplicate credentials or running their own hidden authentication flows.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Connect once, reuse through authorised capabilities
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Examples include a Google connection supplying Drive capabilities to Files, Gmail capabilities to Mail, Calendar capabilities to Planner/Calendar and Contacts capabilities to relevant people pickers; a GitHub connection may supply repository/issue/pull-request capabilities to Build, Build or authorised Dulche Agents.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Provider scope versus 9to1 permission
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: A Connection may possess provider scopes that a particular app, Agent, Skill, Plugin or extension is not authorised to use.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Provider scope versus 9to1 permission
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Both the remote provider scope and the applicable 9to1 permission/capability policy MUST allow an operation before it is executed.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Provider scope versus 9to1 permission
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Connecting an account MUST NOT implicitly grant every 9to1 surface unrestricted access to that account.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Provider scope versus 9to1 permission
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Permission decisions should be made at an appropriate capability/resource scope and remain inspectable/revocable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Typed capability contracts
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Consuming apps SHOULD depend on provider-neutral typed capabilities where equivalent semantics exist instead of embedding provider-specific endpoint logic.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Typed capability contracts
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Provider-specific features that cannot be represented faithfully through a common contract may be exposed through explicit provider-namespaced capabilities; the common abstraction MUST NOT silently discard important provider semantics merely to force false parity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Typed capability contracts
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Capability schemas MUST declare input/output shape, supported operations, required provider scopes, relevant 9to1 permissions, pagination/streaming behaviour, provider limitations and error states.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Authentication and credential storage
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Apps MUST NOT request or persist reusable provider credentials directly when the integration framework can broker them.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Authentication and credential storage
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Credential material such as access tokens, refresh tokens, API keys, passwords and private keys MUST live in approved secure credential storage.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Authentication and credential storage
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: A consumer receives a capability result or typed authentication-required failure, not raw credentials it can reuse arbitrarily.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Scope escalation
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: If a Connection exists but lacks a provider scope required by a new capability, the consuming surface requests scope escalation through the shared integration framework.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Scope escalation
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The user must be shown which additional provider access is being requested and why.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Remote identity and canonical 9to1 entities
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: External objects MUST retain their remote identity and provenance.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Remote identity and canonical 9to1 entities
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: A RemoteEntityReference should identify the provider, Connection, remote object ID, remote revision/version where available, remote URL/reference and any mapped canonical 9to1 entity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Remote identity and canonical 9to1 entities
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The UI and APIs MUST distinguish operations such as Open remote, Import/copy into 9to1, Link/reference and Keep synchronised.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Remote identity and canonical 9to1 entities
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Where an external object is mapped to a canonical 9to1 entity, the relationship must remain explicit so the system does not create multiple disconnected local copies of the same remote item or accidentally treat provider IDs as globally unique without Connection/provider context.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Live, cached, imported and synchronised state
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The integration layer MUST distinguish live remote data, cached metadata, cached content, imported local copies and synchronised mirrors.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Live, cached, imported and synchronised state
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Consuming apps must be able to determine whether displayed information is current, cached, stale or locally diverged.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Live, cached, imported and synchronised state
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Caching policies must respect provider terms, account permissions, data sensitivity and user settings.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Live, cached, imported and synchronised state
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: A cached object must not be presented as live merely because a prior request succeeded.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Sync, webhooks and change feeds
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Where a provider supports webhooks, push notifications or incremental change feeds, the integration framework SHOULD use them rather than each app independently polling the same account.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Sync, webhooks and change feeds
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Polling remains available where required by the provider or capability, but should be centralised enough to avoid redundant traffic and quota consumption.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Sync, webhooks and change feeds
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Sync state must include sufficient cursor/revision information to continue incrementally after restart or temporary offline periods.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Offline and queued-operation behaviour
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Consumers may continue to display authorised cached state while a provider is unavailable, but the stale/offline state and last successful sync/freshness information MUST remain visible when material.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Offline and queued-operation behaviour
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The framework MUST NOT silently claim remote mutations succeeded when they have only been queued locally.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Offline and queued-operation behaviour
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Reconnection must not blindly replay an action that is no longer valid or that already completed remotely.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Conflicts and versioning
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Wall-clock timestamps alone MUST NOT be the only conflict authority.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Conflicts and versioning
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Compatible disjoint edits may be merged where the owning capability can prove a safe merge.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Connection health and failure states
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Health information should include the failing capability/provider account where relevant, last successful contact/sync, retryability and the action required from the user when one exists.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Rate limits and reliability
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: The shared layer MUST centrally support pagination, retry-after handling, provider quotas, transient network retries, exponential backoff/jitter, idempotency, request cancellation, partial response handling and provider-specific service limits.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Rate limits and reliability
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Consuming apps MUST NOT each invent incompatible retry/quota behaviour.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Connection management UI
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: 9to1 MUST provide a central integrations management surface, hosted under the appropriate Home/Settings area, showing provider, connected account identity, connection status, provider-granted scopes/capabilities, authorised 9to1 consumers where exposed, recent/last successful activity, errors, reconnect/re-authorise, permission management and disconnect/revoke actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Connection management UI
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Individual apps may deep-link into this management flow or expose capability-specific connection prompts, but connection state remains owned by the shared framework.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Relationship to Plugins and MCP
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Plugins are installable packages that may add executable/integrated functionality.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Relationship to Plugins and MCP
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: They may interoperate: a Plugin may register a provider adapter; an integration capability may be surfaced to Dulche through an approved tool/MCP bridge.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Relationship to Plugins and MCP
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Such composition MUST preserve the underlying Connection identity, provider scopes and 9to1 permission checks rather than laundering authority through another abstraction.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Provider SDK and extension
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: 9to1 SHOULD expose a versioned Integration Provider SDK/manifest contract so additional providers can be implemented without changing every consuming app.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Disconnect and revocation
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Disconnect semantics MUST be explicit and predictable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Disconnect and revocation
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Disconnecting a Connection should stop sync/background activity, invalidate or remove local credential references as appropriate, disable provider capabilities and clear/expire caches according to policy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Disconnect and revocation
requirements.top_section: Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations
requirements.text: Where supported and requested, provider-side token revocation should also be attempted.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Accounts, web services, cloud storage and integrations > Disconnect and revocation
