requirements.text: A contestant MUST NOT receive another contestant's hidden answer/action, reference solution, hidden role, private inventory/state, unrevealed future round content, judge internals or other protected information unless the rules explicitly reveal it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Isolation, visibility and fairness
requirements.text: Hidden-role, deduction and asymmetric-information games MAY assign different private state to each contestant.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Isolation, visibility and fairness
requirements.text: Private state MUST remain inaccessible to unauthorised contestants, spectator views and model context even if all participants are represented within the same Match.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Isolation, visibility and fairness
requirements.text: Where fairness requires simultaneous decisions, submissions MUST remain sealed until all eligible contestants have submitted or the configured deadline expires.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Canonical game state and rules
requirements.text: Match truth MUST live in canonical structured MatchState rather than in generated commentary.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Canonical game state and rules
requirements.text: Narrative/UI text may describe a state transition only after the corresponding typed transition is accepted by the game engine.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Canonical game state and rules
requirements.text: GameDefinition rules MUST be enforceable independently from contestant prompts where practical.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Canonical game state and rules
requirements.text: Typed constraints may cover legal moves, resource limits, turn ownership, score bounds, prerequisites, timers, elimination, visibility and other deterministic rules.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Canonical game state and rules
requirements.text: An Agent proposing an illegal action receives a structured rejection and may retry according to game policy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Canonical game state and rules
requirements.text: Rule-critical data such as quiz answer keys, legal move generation or score calculations SHOULD use deterministic evaluators where technically appropriate rather than an LLM judge.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Typed game actions
requirements.text: Play MUST NOT depend on parsing arbitrary prose to infer critical actions when a structured action contract is available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Typed game actions
requirements.text: Every available action MUST define input schema, visibility/availability conditions, validation rules and whether the action is reversible before resolution.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Rounds, turns and timing
requirements.text: Play MUST support at least Sequential, Simultaneous and RealTimeLike timing models where required by a GameDefinition.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Rounds, turns and timing
requirements.text: Quiz/race games SHOULD support simultaneous submission; board/strategy games may use sequential turns; other games may use event/timer-driven phases.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Rounds, turns and timing
requirements.text: When speed affects scoring, Play MUST record authoritative presentation/start and submission timestamps from the Match runtime rather than trusting contestant-supplied timing.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Rounds, turns and timing
requirements.text: Pauses/reconnects MUST follow the GameDefinition timing policy and be represented explicitly.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Rounds, turns and timing
requirements.text: Round state SHOULD expose at least Pending, Active, AwaitingSubmissions, Resolving, Revealed and Completed or equivalent typed phases where applicable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Judging and scoring
requirements.text: Every GameDefinition that scores or selects winners MUST declare a JudgePolicy/ScoringPolicy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Judging and scoring
requirements.text: The policy MAY use deterministic rules, human voting, one or more Dulche judge Agents, rubric-based model grading or a combination.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Judging and scoring
requirements.text: Objective domains MUST prefer deterministic evaluation when available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Judging and scoring
requirements.text: For example, maths answers should use symbolic/numeric validation rather than asking an LLM which contestant 'looks correct'.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Judging and scoring
requirements.text: Subjective games such as slogan or creative-writing competitions MAY use transparent Agent/human rubric judging.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Judging and scoring
requirements.text: If model/Agent judging is used, Play MUST record judge identity/model/revision, rubric, inputs available to the judge and resulting score/reasoning artifact where policy allows.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Judging and scoring
requirements.text: A judge MUST NOT receive contestant identity when blind judging is part of the game rules.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Judging and scoring
requirements.text: Scores, penalties, tie-breaks, eliminations and winner resolution MUST be derived from the GameDefinition rules and stored as canonical Match events/state rather than only rendered text.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Tools and capability profiles
requirements.text: A GameDefinition MUST declare the game-specific capability profile available to Agent contestants.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Tools and capability profiles
requirements.text: Tools such as web search, calculators, code execution, Files, Plugins or external connectors may be Allowed, Denied or constrained per game/role.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Tools and capability profiles
requirements.text: Disallowed capabilities MUST be removed/blocked at runtime rather than merely discouraged in instructions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Tools and capability profiles
requirements.text: A research contest may explicitly permit them.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Tools and capability profiles
requirements.text: Simulated game actions MUST remain clearly distinct from real-world side effects.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Teams and collaboration
requirements.text: Play MUST support optional team membership where the GameDefinition permits it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Teams and collaboration
requirements.text: Teams MAY mix human and Agent contestants.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Teams and collaboration
requirements.text: Visibility policy may expose team-private state/chat while hiding it from opposing teams.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Teams and collaboration
requirements.text: A team game may therefore support Human + Agents versus Agents, multiple human/Agent teams or other configured compositions without changing the underlying contestant identity/action model.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Spectator mode
requirements.text: Play MUST support spectator-only Matches in which Agents compete while the user watches.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Spectator mode
requirements.text: Spectator UI MAY expose live round/turn state, locked/submitted indicators, permitted public reasoning/status, reveal events, scores/leaderboard and replay controls according to the GameDefinition visibility policy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Spectator mode
requirements.text: Spectators MUST NOT automatically gain access to hidden contestant/judge state merely because they are not playing.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Game creation and quick starts
requirements.text: Play MUST support conversational game creation from a natural-language request, for example 'Make a 15-question A-Level Maths quiz with increasing difficulty where I compete against 10 AI contestants'.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Game creation and quick starts
requirements.text: The Play landing page SHOULD provide Create with AI, quick-start categories/templates, Continue/Recent Matches, saved/favourite GameDefinitions and available shared templates.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Game creation and quick starts
requirements.text: Candidate categories MAY include Quiz/Knowledge, Strategy, Creative, Deduction/Social and Collaborative/Team games.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Game creation and quick starts
requirements.text: Generated games MUST be real GameDefinitions with typed rules/state/actions rather than a one-off prompt pretending to be a game.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > UI and Generative UI
requirements.text: Play MAY use CUI/Generative UI for question cards, timers, answer controls, boards, maps, cards, inventories, contestant panels, scoreboards, leaderboards, reveal animations and other game-specific interfaces.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > UI and Generative UI
requirements.text: Generated UI MUST bind to typed Play actions/state and MUST NOT become an alternate unsynchronised game engine.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > UI and Generative UI
requirements.text: For a quiz, the primary screen SHOULD make the current question, user's answer control, contestant submission status, round state and leaderboard understandable without exposing hidden answers before reveal.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Voice, images and multimodality
requirements.text: Play MAY use Voice & Vision while preserving the same MatchID/ContestantID/state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Voice, images and multimodality
requirements.text: GameDefinitions MAY use images, generated visuals or other media as questions, assets or submissions where supported.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Voice, images and multimodality
requirements.text: Persistent continuity-critical assets MUST receive canonical asset identity/references rather than being regenerated unpredictably each turn.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Checkpoints, reconnect and replay
requirements.text: Play SHOULD checkpoint canonical MatchState at safe phase/round boundaries and support reconnect/recovery where the game permits.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Checkpoints, reconnect and replay
requirements.text: Recovery MUST preserve sealed submissions, scores and resolved side effects rather than restarting a round invisibly.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Checkpoints, reconnect and replay
requirements.text: Replay/history SHOULD be derived from canonical Match events and Action Graph.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Checkpoints, reconnect and replay
requirements.text: A debug/replay branch MUST NOT alter the original completed Match history.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Play and Experiences interoperability
requirements.text: Experiences MAY launch a Play Match for a formal competition inside a broader scenario; Play MAY offer Continue in Experiences for open-ended continuation after a Match.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Play and Experiences interoperability
requirements.text: Any handoff MUST explicitly map permitted state/artifacts rather than treating MatchState and ExperienceState as the same object.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Canonical Play API
requirements.text: Every user-visible game/match/contestant action MUST have equivalent typed API coverage under the global API-parity rule.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Play > Failure behaviour
requirements.text: Play MUST return structured failures including GameNotFound, GameRevisionUnavailable, InvalidGameDefinition, MatchNotFound, MatchAlreadyStarted, MatchNotJoinable, ContestantNotFound, ContestantNotEligible, ContestantViewDenied, NotContestantTurn, RoundNotActive, SubmissionAlreadyLocked, SubmissionDeadlinePassed, ActionUnavailable, IllegalAction, CapabilityDeniedByGame, JudgeUnavailable, ResolutionFailed, RecoveryUnavailable and RevisionConflict in addition to normal Dulche/Home/tool failures.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Product role and shared virtualisation engine
requirements.text: Mini Computer MUST NOT replace mature hypervisor functionality with a simplified simulation merely to obtain a uniform UI.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Built-in default provider: 9to1 VirtualBox fork
requirements.text: Mini Computer MUST include this provider so a user can create and run supported VMs without first installing or connecting a third-party hypervisor.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Built-in default provider: 9to1 VirtualBox fork
requirements.text: The implementation MUST fork and maintain the latest appropriate VirtualBox source in accordance with the global donor/upstream contract and the applicable open-source licence/third-party licence obligations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > VirtualBox licensing and excluded separately licensed components
requirements.text: Separately licensed proprietary components such as the Oracle Extension Pack MUST NOT be copied, bundled or represented as part of the fork unless CAKE has obtained the required rights.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > VirtualBox licensing and excluded separately licensed components
requirements.text: If a useful donor capability exists only in a separately licensed component, Mini Computer must either provide a legally independent 9to1-native replacement, support a separately user-installed/connected compatible component where lawful, or expose the capability as unavailable with a documented licensing/platform reason.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > VirtualBox licensing and excluded separately licensed components
requirements.text: The implementation architecture SHOULD keep the fork/provider boundary sufficiently clear for licence compliance, update/rebase management and optional alternative-provider support.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Provider abstraction and optional connected providers
requirements.text: The built-in 9to1 VirtualBox fork is selected by default, while users may connect/install additional compatible providers such as QEMU, KVM, Windows hypervisor integrations or extension-contributed providers when supported.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Provider capability matrix
requirements.text: Mini Computer MUST NOT accept a setting and silently ignore it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Provider capability matrix
requirements.text: Capabilities may depend on host architecture and current host configuration, so provider/version support and effective host support are distinct states.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Canonical VirtualMachine model
requirements.text: Renaming, moving in UI or changing provider display labels MUST NOT alter VMID.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > VM lifecycle states
requirements.text: Closing or losing a viewer MUST NOT cause the UI to report PoweredOff if the VM remains running.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > VM lifecycle states
requirements.text: Mini Computer MUST NOT report Start/Shutdown/Save successful until the provider confirms the resulting state or the operation explicitly remains Pending.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > New VM wizard
requirements.text: Create VM provides a guided workflow for guest OS family/version, architecture, installation media, CPU, RAM, storage, firmware/security, networking and optional unattended installation, with Advanced settings available before creation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Guest/ISO detection
requirements.text: Detection may propose suitable CPU, memory, disk, firmware, TPM/Secure Boot and guest-integration settings while preserving user control.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Curated ISO Browser
requirements.text: Catalogue entries may include operating-system family/distribution, publisher, edition/channel, version, architecture, desktop/server variant, approximate size, source/provider, acquisition policy, integrity metadata availability, licence/redistribution policy and branding/trademark usage metadata where relevant.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Curated ISO Browser
requirements.text: Representative trusted publisher sources may include Microsoft, Canonical/Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch, openSUSE, FreeBSD, 9to1 OS and other audited providers.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > ISO acquisition policies
requirements.text: MirrorPermitted — CAKE may mirror/cache the exact permitted unmodified image only when redistribution rights/policy expressly allow it and all required licence/notices/provenance are preserved.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > ISO acquisition policies
requirements.text: UserSupplied — Mini Computer can identify/configure the guest but the user must select media they already lawfully possess.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > ISO Browser user flow
requirements.text: Any required login/product/licence flow remains the publisher's official flow.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Media library and cleanup
requirements.text: If the medium is still mounted or required for a configured boot workflow, deletion/removal shows the affected VMs and requires appropriate confirmation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Unattended installation
requirements.text: Where the guest/provider supports it, users may opt into unattended OS installation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Unattended installation
requirements.text: Configuration can include hostname, locale, time zone, user/account setup, product/licence information where required, disk install choices and guest integration installation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Interactive VM viewer
requirements.text: The viewer may be embedded or popped out to a dedicated window while retaining the same VMID/session state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Interactive VM viewer
requirements.text: Viewer disconnect/reconnect is separate from VM lifecycle and must not power off or duplicate the VM unless explicitly requested.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Power and state controls
requirements.text: The UI/API MUST NOT label destructive power-off as graceful shutdown.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Snapshots
requirements.text: Deleting/consolidating a snapshot MUST NOT silently delete a dependent branch/linked clone.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Cloning and linked clones
requirements.text: Deleting/moving a required base is blocked or performs a deliberate consolidation/migration first.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Storage controllers and boot order
requirements.text: Mini Computer exposes provider-supported controllers such as NVMe, SATA, SCSI and legacy IDE/other controllers when required.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Storage controllers and boot order
requirements.text: Mounting a new ISO MUST NOT silently rewrite persistent boot policy unless requested.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > CPU and memory configuration
requirements.text: It must not silently overcommit resources while presenting them as guaranteed.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Firmware, Secure Boot and TPM
requirements.text: Guest templates/detection can recommend required firmware/security configuration, especially for modern operating systems, while exposing the actual setting.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > USB and device passthrough
requirements.text: Where provider/platform support exists, users may attach/detach USB devices and configure explicit passthrough/filter policies.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Audio and microphone
requirements.text: Microphone input follows host privacy/device permission rules and MUST NOT silently activate because the VM starts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Clipboard and drag/drop trust policy
requirements.text: Guest integration installation alone MUST NOT silently enable bidirectional host data access.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Shared folders
requirements.text: The UI/AI verification must make writable scope clear.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Guest integrations
requirements.text: Mini Computer MUST NOT bundle separately licensed donor guest components without the necessary rights.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Templates and reusable machine profiles
requirements.text: Template has stable TemplateID, guest/provider requirements, hardware defaults, media/acquisition references, optional bootstrap/unattended settings and Revision.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > First-party guest templates
requirements.text: Mini Computer may ship configuration templates for common operating systems without bundling proprietary installation images unless distribution rights permit it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > First-party guest templates
requirements.text: A template may state ISO required and route the user into the ISO Browser/provider flow rather than implying the operating system is included.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Files and storage architecture
requirements.text: Exact physical layout may vary by storage provider but remains user-inspectable where appropriate.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Files and storage architecture
requirements.text: Very large mutable virtual disks/snapshot chains may use a block/storage provider optimised for VM workloads rather than ordinary sync semantics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Terminal integration
requirements.text: Build MUST NOT maintain a parallel private hypervisor implementation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Headless operation
requirements.text: VMs may run without an open viewer.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Headless operation
requirements.text: A background/service component owns provider sessions that must survive the UI process.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > AI / Dulche integration
requirements.text: AI MUST NOT hide consequential operations behind generic wording.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Extension system
requirements.text: Extensions may contribute VirtualisationProvider implementations, ISO catalogue/acquisition providers, guest templates/integration providers, device/network/storage adapters, inspectors and diagnostics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Extension system
requirements.text: Provider extensions declare host/platform compatibility, required privileges and permissions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Accessibility
requirements.text: VM lifecycle/provider/security state MUST NOT rely solely on colour or icons.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Performance and scalability
requirements.text: UI rendering MUST NOT require loading every virtual disk/snapshot into memory.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Recovery and failure behaviour
requirements.text: Partial provider/storage operations return succeeded/failed/remaining resources and recovery steps; Mini Computer MUST NOT report rollback/cleanup success unless verified.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Mini Computer > Platform capability behaviour
requirements.text: Web surfaces may manage/view remote Mini Computer providers/VMs when an authorised remote execution provider exists but MUST NOT pretend the browser itself can provide unrestricted local hardware virtualisation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Admin MUST have Windows, 9to1-OS and browser/web surfaces sharing the same CAKE ID, organisation entities, domain APIs and permission evaluation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Unsupported capabilities MUST remain distinguishable from denied permission or an offline device.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Admin MUST invoke these canonical services rather than create duplicate content, Agent registries, payment records or a competing permission broker.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The start screen MUST list organisations the user can manage, with an explicit organisation switcher and current organisation identity on every administrative screen.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Navigation MUST include Overview; People; Roles & Permissions; Policies; Models, Apps & Features; Plugins & Settings; Usage & Credits; Billing; Team Space & Drive; Connect; Devices & Mesh; Team Agents; and Audit & Activity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Visibility is permission-filtered, while denial states explain the required capability without leaking inaccessible organisations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Overview MUST show member/seat counts, resource allocation and consumption, pending invitations/approvals, policy-deployment status, blocked actions, device health and billing state, each with source freshness.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Unknown or stale values MUST NOT appear as zero or healthy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Search, filtering, accessible keyboard operation, bulk-selection previews and per-item bulk results are required.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Authorised owners MUST be able to create and edit organisation identity, manage ownership, inspect linked Business entitlement, archive/reactivate the organisation and request export or deletion.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Ownership transfer requires authenticated acceptance by the recipient; removing or suspending the last active owner MUST be rejected.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Deletion requires an impact preview, explicit confirmation and the applicable retention/export workflow, and MUST NOT delete a member’s personal account or personal artifacts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: People management MUST support invite, resend/revoke invitation, accept, list/search, assign/change roles, suspend, reinstate and remove membership.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Membership states MUST distinguish Invited, Active, Suspended and Removed, with stable MembershipID and UserID.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Acceptance and capacity reservation MUST be transactional so concurrent requests cannot bypass the seat cap.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The UI MUST distinguish members, pending/reserved invitations and external Connect correspondents; corresponding counting rules must be explicit, not hidden billing assumptions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Roles MUST be editable capability sets, not just labels.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Custom roles MUST support scoped read, add/edit, delete/recovery and specialised administrative actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A role editor MUST show effective permissions and inherited restrictions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A delegated administrator MUST NOT grant capabilities outside their own delegation boundary, elevate themselves to owner or modify protected grants.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Suspension/removal MUST revoke organisation sessions/capabilities, block new organisation-funded jobs, remove applicable shared access and reconcile owned organisation resources and outstanding reservations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Revocation MUST leave personal accounts and unrelated organisations intact; offline devices must report pending revocation until enforcement is acknowledged.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Administrators MUST be able to enforce organisation-wide and role-specific policies, inspect their effective result for a selected member/device/Agent, and preview affected objects before publication.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: PolicySet and PolicyAssignment records MUST carry stable IDs, schema version, revision, scope, author, effective time and change reason.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Restrictions MUST cover model/provider access; apps; individual app features/actions; Plugins and their capabilities; Agents and Automations, including creation, editing, invocation, schedules and external side effects.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Restricted capabilities must be enforced by the owning service at dispatch, not merely hidden in the UI.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A denial at a required boundary cannot be overridden by a broader grant elsewhere.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Conflicting mandatory settings or required-versus-blocked Plugin rules MUST produce a validation conflict instead of an arbitrary last-write-wins outcome.

requirements.group_title: Required Plugins, forced settings and default models
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Admin MUST support required organisation-wide Plugins and additional requirements by role, with package identity, approved version/update policy, required configuration and deployment status.

requirements.group_title: Required Plugins, forced settings and default models
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Required does not mean silently trusted: package integrity, compatibility, requested scopes and secret connections must validate before enablement.

requirements.group_title: Required Plugins, forced settings and default models
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A blocked or failed required Plugin produces an actionable non-compliance state.

requirements.group_title: Required Plugins, forced settings and default models
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Disabling an unsafe Plugin remains possible for authorised security response; updates cannot widen permissions without the required approval.

requirements.group_title: Required Plugins, forced settings and default models
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Administrators MUST be able to force supported organisation/role settings and separately supply editable defaults.

requirements.group_title: Required Plugins, forced settings and default models
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Settings must be addressed by versioned typed keys supported by the target app/device; unsupported settings cannot be reported as applied.

requirements.group_title: Required Plugins, forced settings and default models
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Default-model configuration MUST support organisation defaults and role-specific defaults, plus permitted user overrides.

requirements.group_title: Required Plugins, forced settings and default models
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The effective model must also satisfy model restrictions, entitlement, capability, privacy and local/cloud routing rules.

requirements.group_title: Required Plugins, forced settings and default models
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: An unavailable or prohibited default blocks with a clear reason or uses an explicitly authorised fallback; it MUST NOT silently send private local-only content to a cloud provider.

requirements.group_title: Required Plugins, forced settings and default models
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Conflicting forced role defaults must be resolved explicitly in policy configuration before publication.

requirements.group_title: Subscription assignment, usage controls and rollover
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Usage & Credits MUST let authorised administrators assign a funded subscription/resource configuration to a member or role, choose a shared organisation pool or individually partitioned allocations, set limits, inspect consumption/reservations and move eligible unspent organisation-owned allocation between partitions.

requirements.group_title: Subscription assignment, usage controls and rollover
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Changing a display tier or role MUST NOT mint credits, unlock an unfunded model band or duplicate an allocation.

requirements.group_title: Subscription assignment, usage controls and rollover
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Controls MUST include organisation, role and member ceilings for AI usage and applicable storage/site resources; warnings and hard-stop behaviour; configured time windows; and model/Agent/Automation attribution.

requirements.group_title: Subscription assignment, usage controls and rollover
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Reports MUST separate allocated, available, reserved, consumed, rolled-over and expired credits and display the reset/expiry policy and freshness.

requirements.group_title: Subscription assignment, usage controls and rollover
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Admins MUST be able to configure, by role, whether eligible expired/expiring credits may roll over, with explicit inheritance, allow or disallow settings and the supported carryover period/cap.

requirements.group_title: Subscription assignment, usage controls and rollover
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Members MUST see their effective rollover rule.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Billing MUST expose the current Business add-on, seat capacity, funded resource configurations, invoice/payment status and authorised invoice download, plus a preview of changes and their effective date.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Usage allocation may change resource cost, but an invitation or role assignment must not conceal a seat charge.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Approval must be bound to the quote/version and protected against replay; a changed or expired quote requires a new decision.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Analytics MUST offer permission-filtered totals and breakdowns by period, member, role, model, app, Agent and pool, with exportable reports and reconciliation to ledger events.

requirements.group_title: Shared resources, devices and team Agents
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Team Space & Drive MUST manage organisation ownership, role/group access, sharing restrictions, storage limits, access reviews, archival/recovery and export through Spaces/Files.

requirements.group_title: Shared resources, devices and team Agents
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Connect management MUST cover the organisation directory, channels/groups, delegated organisational identities, allowed external contact and Agent channel bindings through Connect.

requirements.group_title: Shared resources, devices and team Agents
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Devices & Mesh MUST expose enrolled devices, owner/account, platform, supported capabilities, trust/enrolment state, last contact, effective policy and resource contributions.

requirements.group_title: Shared resources, devices and team Agents
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Authorised actions MUST include enrolment approval, group/role assignment, policy deployment, access/resource revocation and inspection of acknowledged enforcement.

requirements.group_title: Shared resources, devices and team Agents
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Team Agents MUST list canonical organisation Agents and support create/import, assign owner/scope, edit/publish versions, configure model/tools/required Plugins and budgets, share invocation access, schedule approved work, pause/resume/stop, archive/recover and inspect authorised run history.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Consequential management actions MUST record AuditEventID, OrgID, verified actor/delegation, action and target IDs, timestamp, policy/revision, approval reference where required, redacted before/after state and observed outcome.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Unknown billing/external-action outcomes must be reconciled before retry.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Offline administrative clients may inspect permitted cached metadata with a stale marker but cannot assert that a new server policy or purchase has taken effect.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Canonical records MUST include Organisation, Membership, Role, CapabilityGrant, PolicySet, PolicyAssignment, ResourcePool, MemberAllocation, CreditLot, DeviceEnrolment, MeshGrant, TeamAgentBinding, Approval, AdminJob and AuditEvent.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Every action contract MUST declare typed arguments/results, permission scope, risk, reversibility and external effects.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Acceptance MUST prove: a non-Business account cannot gain Admin capabilities; Business access without an admin role does not grant privileged operations; Jacob’s verified free grant works without enabling another account; a Business organisation with 50 active seats cannot admit a 51st concurrently; and Business + has no subscription seat cap while ordinary resource/security limits still apply.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: End-to-end tests MUST cover organisation ownership transfer and last-owner protection; invite/suspend/remove with immediate server access revocation; custom-role restrictions through UI and direct API; blocked models/apps/features/Plugins/Automations; required Plugins by organisation and role; forced settings and default-model conflicts; shared versus individual budgets; role-based rollover; concurrency-safe credit reservation/settlement; itemised quote approval and retry protection; shared-resource ACLs; cross-account Mesh opt-in/revocation; and team-Agent isolation and lifecycle.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Platform tests MUST cover Windows, 9to1-OS and web, including browser administration without local Home, unsupported endpoint controls and offline rollout remaining pending.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Lists MUST remain paginated, exports/rollouts asynchronous where long-running, and expensive reports must not block policy checks.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Product role and core invariant
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Natural-language phrasing MUST NOT lower safety.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Persistent AI / Command mode switcher
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: It MUST NOT route ordinary recognised shell commands through an LLM merely because AI is available.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Persistent AI / Command mode switcher
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: AI Mode interprets user input as natural-language intent, resolves the appropriate typed 9to1/system action or shell operation, presents verification when required and then executes through the owning supported APIs/runtime.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Command Mode
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Terminal may enrich recognised output with clickable links or structured metadata, but the original output stream remains faithful and recoverable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > $Ask non-executing AI assistance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: $Ask may receive permission-scoped context such as the immediately preceding command, exit status, selected/recent relevant output, shell/profile, environment type, working directory and registered project context.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > $Ask non-executing AI assistance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: It MUST NOT indiscriminately send the whole terminal history or detected secrets.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > $Ask non-executing AI assistance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The user may copy or insert a suggestion into Command Mode, after which it is treated as ordinary user-entered command input.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > $Ask non-executing AI assistance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: $Ask itself MUST NOT invoke a hidden command, app mutation, package install, process kill or external side effect.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > $Ask non-executing AI assistance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: An explicit transition to AI Mode or separate Run/Insert action is required for execution.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > AI execution verification and dangerous-command protection
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: AI Mode may execute low-risk, clearly resolved actions according to the user's existing trust/permission policy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > AI execution verification and dangerous-command protection
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Ambiguous natural-language requests that could resolve to materially different consequential actions MUST pause for clarification/selection rather than choosing the more destructive interpretation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Real PTY and shell behaviour
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Closing, resizing or switching UI panes MUST NOT convert an interactive shell into one-shot process execution.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Real PTY and shell behaviour
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Where the platform cannot expose a local PTY, Terminal uses a declared remote/service terminal provider or reports CapabilityUnavailable; it MUST NOT simulate successful local shell execution.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Tabs, panes and window layouts
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Restoration recreates UI/session context according to policy but MUST NOT blindly rerun previously entered commands or consequential jobs.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Working directory and path semantics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Files integration adds stable identity/navigation where possible without replacing required filesystem paths.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Shell integration protocol
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Terminal MUST NOT require modifying every third-party shell to provide basic terminal behaviour.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Command and output history
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: History records whether an AI suggestion was merely shown, inserted, or actually executed; the UI MUST NOT imply execution from proposal alone.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Streaming output and semantic links
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Terminal may additionally recognise file:line references, directories, URLs, ports, process IDs, compiler diagnostics, Git/Build identities and other registered entities.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Streaming output and semantic links
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Recognised entities become optional clickable actions such as Open in Build, Show in Files or Open in Haven without altering the underlying captured output.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Rich Terminal-native output
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: 9to1-owned commands/actions and registered extensions MAY emit structured terminal blocks such as tables, progress, diagnostics, file results, images/previews or action cards where the terminal surface supports them.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Rich Terminal-native output
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Structured output always has an accessible text representation and MUST NOT make standard stdout/stderr consumers depend on a proprietary renderer.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Long-running processes and jobs
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Structured AI/system work may use TerminalJob with stable JobID, source request, resolved action, environment, process/provider identity, state, progress where real progress exists, timestamps, result/exit status and cancellation capability.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Long-running processes and jobs
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Terminal MUST NOT fabricate percentage progress for raw commands that do not expose meaningful progress.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Persistent scheduling
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Closing Terminal MUST NOT silently cancel a persistent scheduled action unless that behaviour was explicitly selected.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Elevation and privileged sessions
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A normal session MUST NOT silently become permanently elevated because one command required elevation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > SSH and remote terminals
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Passwords/private keys are handled by shared secure credential infrastructure where possible and MUST NOT be copied into AI context/history/logs unnecessarily.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > SSH and remote terminals
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A host-key mismatch is a security error requiring explicit resolution; Terminal MUST NOT silently accept changed remote identity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Container, WSL and VM terminals
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Build's OS/VM run configurations may expose VM shell/serial/debug consoles through the shared Terminal engine.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > First-class Data integration
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Structured Data results may render as accessible terminal tables and provide Open in Data.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > First-class integration with all 9to1 apps
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Every 9to1 app MAY register a Terminal integration provider exposing discoverable read/actions, context resolvers, entity links, completion/help metadata and structured renderers through the shared API model.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > 9to1 command-line bridge
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Terminal SHOULD provide a scriptable 9to1 CLI/command bridge for canonical app APIs, with discoverable namespaces/actions, machine-readable output option, stable exit codes and authentication/permission behaviour consistent with Home.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Package and tool installation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: AI Mode may resolve requests such as "install numpy" or "install the missing C++ compiler" only after resolving the intended project/environment/package manager/toolchain.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Package and tool installation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A Python project using a selected virtual environment MUST NOT silently install globally.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Package and tool installation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Package/system installation is a mutating/elevated action classified appropriately and shows target environment, package/tool and provider before execution when verification is required.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Error assistance and diagnostics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Terminal recognises failed commands through shell integration/exit codes where available. $Ask can explain the failure without executing fixes; AI Mode can separately propose and, after required verification, perform remediation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Error assistance and diagnostics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Terminal can classify common issues such as executable missing, PATH/toolchain mismatch, permission/elevation required, dependency/package failure, working-directory problem, network/SSH failure or Build guard rejection.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Search, scrollback and large output
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Terminal supports plain/case/regex search over retained session output and optionally across retained buffers/history according to privacy settings.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Clipboard and multiline paste safety
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Multiline paste is detected and may require review/warning according to security settings and content risk.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Clipboard and multiline paste safety
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Paste protection MUST NOT silently rewrite commands.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Secrets, privacy and AI-context filtering
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Terminal assumes arbitrary third-party processes may print secrets.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Secrets, privacy and AI-context filtering
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: AI context construction uses scoped recent/selected data and applies configured secret-pattern redaction plus known credential references, but Terminal MUST NOT claim perfect secret detection.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Command risk metadata and audit
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Manual raw shell commands are not reclassified as if Terminal semantically understood every side effect, but privileged/guarded platform integrations may emit audit events where required.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Completion, aliases and snippets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Terminal supports shell-native completion and may augment it with registered command/app/entity providers.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Completion, aliases and snippets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: AI is not required for ordinary tab completion.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Dulche context and behaviour
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Dulche context for Terminal may include current TerminalSessionID, mode, EnvironmentID, shell profile, working directory, selected/recent command groups, exit code, current process, Build workspace/Build domain and registered app context subject to permissions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Dulche context and behaviour
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: AI output MUST distinguish commands it suggests from operations it actually executed, and execution claims must be grounded in real process/API results.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Extension system
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Extensions may contribute shell profiles, environment providers, completion providers, semantic recognisers, structured renderers, Terminal-native commands, context providers and integrations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Performance and resilience
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: One noisy process MUST NOT freeze unrelated Terminal panes or the whole 9to1 shell.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Recovery and typed failures
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Terminal MUST NOT claim a command/action completed merely because it was proposed or started.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Terminal > Platform capability behaviour
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: It MUST NOT present browser-side simulation as host terminal access.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Other apps MUST consume Maps entities, APIs and embeddable CUI surfaces rather than independently inventing incompatible place, route or location models.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Primary donor and default provider stack
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The maintained 9to1 Maps fork/adaptation MUST preserve applicable CoMaps mapping, offline-map, POI, favourites, tracks, navigation and route-planning functionality and mature quality-of-life behaviour unless this specification explicitly replaces it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Primary donor and default provider stack
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: 9to1 Maps MUST separate the donor application from provider services behind typed interfaces.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Primary donor and default provider stack
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: GTFS/GTFS-Realtime-compatible transit data through a typed transit provider; an OpenTripPlanner-compatible implementation may be used where appropriate.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Primary donor and default provider stack
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Traffic, satellite, terrain, street-level imagery and specialist datasets as optional provider capabilities rather than hard-coded assumptions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Primary donor and default provider stack
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The implementation MUST NOT make public OpenStreetMap community tile or public Nominatim endpoints an unlimited production dependency.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Primary donor and default provider stack
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Provider-specific usage, caching, attribution, redistribution and offline-storage rules MUST be enforced. 9to1-hosted/self-hosted services and user-connected providers can be substituted through the same typed provider contracts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Primary donor and default provider stack
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Rendering, map data, geocoding, search, routing, transit, traffic, imagery and offline datasets MUST be independently replaceable where technically possible.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Primary donor and default provider stack
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Provider identity, provenance, freshness and required attribution MUST remain available to Maps.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Canonical geospatial entities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Maps MUST define stable canonical entities rather than allowing each app to store copied address strings.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Canonical geospatial entities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: At minimum, the typed model must cover Place, Address, Coordinate, Route, RouteLeg, RouteStep, SavedPlace, PersonalLandmark, CommunityPOI, MapView, SearchResult, SearchProvider, MapProviderReference and SavedRoute/CustomJourney or equivalent strongly typed contracts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Canonical geospatial entities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A Place may reference one or more provider records, OpenStreetMap objects, community objects or user-authored data without making any single provider identifier the canonical 9to1 identity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Canonical geospatial entities
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Planner, Events, Spaces, Boards, Write, Present, Forms, Automations and other apps MUST reference canonical Place/Route/Landmark IDs through typed APIs where a persistent location relationship is required.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Search / AI interaction
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Maps MUST use the same explicit Search / AI interaction pattern established elsewhere in 9to1. Search is the default mode.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Search / AI interaction
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: It must search, as applicable, addresses, postcodes, coordinates, named places, businesses/POIs, categories, saved places, PersonalLandmarks, CommunityPOIs and supported 9to1 entities with attached locations.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Search / AI interaction
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Provider result confidence and ambiguity MUST remain visible; Maps MUST NOT fabricate an exact address or place identity from weak geocoding.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Search / AI interaction
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Requests such as 'take me to the nearest Starbucks', 'find somewhere quiet to study within a 15-minute walk', 'find a bench along this route' or 'add a coffee stop halfway home' MUST be resolved through real search/location/routing capabilities rather than invented model knowledge.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Search / AI interaction
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A request such as 'take me to the nearest Starbucks' should resolve the permitted current location, search real place providers, rank valid candidates according to the user's request and actual route/travel distance where available, resolve the chosen candidate to a canonical Place, calculate a route and start/present navigation according to the explicit user intent.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Search / AI interaction
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: If multiple interpretations materially affect the result, Maps must present candidates or request the minimum necessary disambiguation rather than guessing.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Saved places and personal landmarks
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Users MUST be able to drop a pin at any coordinate, name it, optionally categorise it, add notes/metadata, save it privately, share it explicitly and navigate to it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Saved places and personal landmarks
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Creating a private landmark MUST NOT implicitly publish its coordinates, name, notes or category to the community database or an external provider.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Community POIs and landmark presets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Maps MUST provide a first-class community POI system so users can contribute useful hyperlocal geographic data over time.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Community POIs and landmark presets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A category can expose optional structured attributes appropriate to that object.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Community POIs and landmark presets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: For example, a Bench may record backrest, armrests, cover, capacity, material, accessibility or condition; a Bin may record waste/recycling type and condition.
