requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Community POIs and landmark presets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The common contribution path MUST remain fast: a user can submit a useful POI with minimal required fields and enrich it later.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Community POIs and landmark presets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: CommunityPOI records must retain stable identity, coordinate, category, structured attributes, source/provenance, creation/update metadata, verification state, edit history, confidence/quality information and reports/flags as applicable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Community POIs and landmark presets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The community system MUST support a quality lifecycle such as Submitted/Unverified, Community-confirmed and Verified, together with corrections such as Removed, Wrong location, Wrong category, Duplicate and Details changed.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Community POIs and landmark presets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Before creating a public POI, Maps SHOULD perform deterministic nearby duplicate detection using distance, category compatibility and known identifiers.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Community POIs and landmark presets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Where a community contribution maps cleanly to OpenStreetMap semantics, Maps MAY separately offer an explicit 'Contribute to OpenStreetMap' flow subject to OSM account, licensing, validation and editing rules.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Community POIs and landmark presets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Public submission to the 9to1 community database MUST NOT silently publish to OpenStreetMap or another third party.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Routing and route planning
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Maps MUST support route planning for driving, walking, cycling and public transport where the active providers/data support those modes, with typed extension points for additional modes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Routing and route planning
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Normal route building in Search mode MUST allow selecting an origin/destination, adding intermediate places, reordering/removing stops and editing route preferences without invoking AI.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Saved custom routes / Custom Journeys
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Users MUST be able to build, name, save, edit, duplicate, share and later start reusable custom routes/journeys.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Saved custom routes / Custom Journeys
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A SavedRoute/CustomJourney must support ordered typed steps such as TravelStep, StopStep, WaitStep, ActivityStep and ManualInstructionStep or equivalent.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Saved custom routes / Custom Journeys
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Each step may include a canonical Place/Landmark/Coordinate reference, transport mode, optional timing or stop duration, notes, routing preferences and required/preferred/optional semantics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Saved custom routes / Custom Journeys
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Users may create user-defined path segments that are not present in provider routing graphs, for example a campus cut-through, alley, informal footpath or other personally known shortcut.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Saved custom routes / Custom Journeys
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Such segments MUST be visibly marked as user-defined/unverified by provider routing data and MUST NOT be presented as provider-validated infrastructure.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Saved custom routes / Custom Journeys
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: AI mode can create and edit SavedRoutes from natural language, for example: 'Create my Walk to College route: walk to the bench by the river, sit there for ten minutes, grab coffee from Z, take the shortcut behind the library, then turn right to college.' Dulche resolves real referenced entities where possible and must present ambiguity rather than hallucinating a landmark.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Saved custom routes / Custom Journeys
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Private landmark details must not be leaked merely because a route is shared; sharing semantics must explicitly handle private dependencies.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Navigation to arbitrary/custom destinations
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Routing SHOULD bring the user to the closest supported route-graph point and then represent the actual final coordinate honestly rather than inventing a road/entrance.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Navigation to arbitrary/custom destinations
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Custom/community destinations must participate in navigation, route sharing, Planner/Event references and Dulche requests just like provider-defined places, while retaining provenance and verification status.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Live information and dynamic routing
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Live-looking information MUST retain provider provenance and freshness timestamps/state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Live information and dynamic routing
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Stale data MUST NOT be represented as current.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Live information and dynamic routing
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Saved/custom journeys may be dynamically rerouted around disruptions while preserving required user-authored stops/instructions where feasible.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Live information and dynamic routing
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: If a required custom/user-defined segment cannot be validated or becomes impractical, Maps must surface the conflict rather than silently deleting that instruction.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Location permissions and privacy
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Maps/Home permissions MUST distinguish at least resolving a known PlaceID, searching places, approximate current location, precise current location and background location.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Location permissions and privacy
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Sensitive location history MUST NOT automatically become globally indexed Go content or extension-readable data.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Offline operation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Maps MUST retain mature CoMaps-derived offline capability and support downloadable regions where data/provider licences permit.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Offline operation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Offline mode should support map rendering and, where the retained/local datasets allow it, place search/geocoding and routing without requiring a live cloud service.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Offline operation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Downloaded region management must show storage usage, version/freshness and update state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Offline operation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Licence/provider rules govern whether particular imagery/tiles/datasets may be cached or redistributed; unsupported offline caching MUST fail explicitly rather than silently violating provider terms.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > CUI embeds and cross-app composition
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: It MUST expose reusable typed CUI components such as PlaceCard, MapView/MiniMap, LocationPicker, RouteCard and Journey/Navigation surfaces so other 9to1 apps can embed real Maps functionality without cloning it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > CUI embeds and cross-app composition
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Maps MUST be available as the real native surface through 9to1://Maps and support typed deep links to canonical place/route/journey objects.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Dulche integration
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Natural-language context such as 'near me', 'near college', 'between here and home', 'along this route', 'around that place' or 'the restaurant I just looked at' must resolve against real permitted Maps state: current location, SavedPlaces, selected Places, active route/journey and recent canonical Maps entities.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Automations and extensions
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Maps may expose automation triggers such as arrive at place, leave place, enter/exit radius, material route-duration change or transit disruption where platform/background capabilities and permissions support them.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Automations and extensions
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Persistent/background location requires explicit OS/Home permission and MUST NOT be inferred from ordinary foreground Maps access.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Automations and extensions
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Extensions may add providers, overlays, POI categories, route modes, map layers or specialist geospatial tools through typed capability contracts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Safety, provenance and disclaimer
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Maps MUST present map and calculated route data as guidance rather than guaranteed ground truth.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Safety, provenance and disclaimer
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A displayed road, path, crossing, entrance, restriction, building, POI or route MUST NOT be represented as guaranteed to exist, be accessible, be legal to use or be safe merely because it appears in provider/community data.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Safety, provenance and disclaimer
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The following compact user-facing disclaimer is required in Maps and MUST be available during route/navigation use: 'Map data is sourced by third party providers and community volunteers.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Safety, provenance and disclaimer
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A fuller safety/data notice may additionally explain that provider/community data can be incomplete, inaccurate or outdated and that users should follow real-world signs, restrictions and conditions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Safety, provenance and disclaimer
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Community/unverified objects must expose verification/provenance state where relevant and MUST NOT be styled in a way that falsely implies the same confidence as independently established/provider-verified data.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Maps acceptance requirements
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Saved custom routes support typed travel/stop/wait/activity/manual steps, required/preferred/optional intent, user-defined shortcut/path segments, AI creation/editing and safe sharing.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Maps > Maps acceptance requirements
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The required route/data disclaimer and provenance/freshness states are present; Maps never represents provider/community route data as guaranteed real-world truth.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Launcher MUST NOT be implemented as the cross-platform 9to1 package installer/updater or as the Shelf quick-access library.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Lawnchair donor authority
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Applicable donor functionality and quality-of-life behaviour MUST be retained unless this specification explicitly replaces it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Extreme customisation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Launcher MUST expose unusually deep customisation while preserving usable defaults.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Extreme customisation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The architecture must avoid hard-coding one visual layout so additional options can be added without rewriting core launcher state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Extreme customisation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Launcher should offer strong defaults and discoverable presets so extreme customisation does not require every user to configure dozens of controls before the launcher is usable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Applications and stable identity
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Launcher placement MUST reference stable InstalledApplication/Application IDs from the authoritative platform registry rather than raw executable/package paths.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Applications and stable identity
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Updating an app must not destroy its home-screen placement, folder membership or configured icon unless the application's canonical identity actually changes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Applications and stable identity
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Launcher may surface status/actions such as 'update available' but delegates execution to the authoritative package service.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Widgets
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Launcher MUST present both through a coherent placement/resizing model without pretending they share identical runtime/security semantics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Dulche integration
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Dulche MUST operate on canonical launcher entities and honour the same profile, permission and package boundaries as manual actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Search and Go integration
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Launcher search SHOULD consume Go providers/results where appropriate and render them in Launcher context rather than implementing an incompatible second system-wide index.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Profiles and OS boundaries
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Launcher MUST respect Android/OS user, work-profile and application-profile boundaries.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Launcher > Profiles and OS boundaries
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Profile-specific apps/widgets/shortcuts must retain their owning profile identity and should be visually distinguishable where confusion could cause the user to act under the wrong account or authority.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Core model
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Shelf MUST model launch targets as stable typed LaunchItem entities rather than a grid of copied shortcuts.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Core model
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Each LaunchItem can retain a stable ID, name, icon/artwork, target type, canonical target/reference, optional launch parameters, tags, collection membership, launch behaviour and supported contextual actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Core model
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Shelf MUST preserve the underlying target identity instead of duplicating the actual app/game/file.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Collections and organisation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The same LaunchItem may appear in multiple collections without duplication.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Collections and organisation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Shelf MUST support manual collections, favourites/pins, ordering, tags and smart/dynamic collections where reliable typed criteria exist.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Collections and organisation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Dynamic collections may automatically surface targets such as detected Unreal projects or installed games matching declared offline-capability metadata without converting those results into duplicate LaunchItems.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Collections and organisation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Collections should support configurable presentation such as list/grid/card density, artwork/icon treatment and ordering while keeping the same canonical contents underneath.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Discovery and target import
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Discovery MUST be permission-aware and reversible; detected items do not have to be added to the user's curated Shelf unless the user chooses or a configured smart collection references them.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Discovery and target import
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Missing/uninstalled targets SHOULD remain recoverable as unavailable entries when preserving them is useful, rather than silently deleting the user's organisation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Search / AI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Dulche MUST resolve real discovered/canonical targets and MUST NOT invent installed applications or projects.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Launching and actions
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Shelf may expose typed contextual actions such as Open, Open with, Reveal in Files, Open project, Launch with arguments, Pin, Add/remove collection, Edit metadata or provider-specific actions where the underlying target supports them.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Cross-device and missing-target behaviour
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Shelf organisation is user state and should be serialisable/synchronisable where enabled.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Cross-device and missing-target behaviour
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A synced collection may contain a target unavailable on another device.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Cross-device and missing-target behaviour
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: That device MUST represent the item as unavailable/not installed or resolve an appropriate equivalent only through explicit canonical mapping; it must not silently substitute an unrelated app.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > Shelf > Extensions
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Extensions may register LaunchItem providers, target types, discovery providers, metadata enrichers, actions and smart-collection predicates subject to permissions.

requirements.group_title: Link shell, documents and shared content
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L01 — Link shell, documents and shared content
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The launch screen and New menu MUST distinguish them by both name and preview: Flow is a continuous page; Binder is an explorable interconnected document.

requirements.group_title: Link shell, documents and shared content
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L01 — Link shell, documents and shared content
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Link MUST NOT offer Sheet as a third document type or use Boards as the name of Binder.

requirements.group_title: Link shell, documents and shared content
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L01 — Link shell, documents and shared content
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The editor MUST expose the current document type, outline/search, Insert, source management, preview/view mode, undo/redo, save/sync/history and sharing.

requirements.group_title: Link shell, documents and shared content
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L01 — Link shell, documents and shared content
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The distinction MUST be visible in the inspector and destructive-action wording.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Flow MUST render selected documents and other content inline in one chosen reading order, with one primary vertical scroll.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: It MUST not be a column of file icons, buttons to open pop-ups or permanently nested vertically scrolling document panels.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The content width, typography integration and transitions MUST form a coherent page while preserving the owning source's meaningful content.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Large tables may use local horizontal navigation; interactive media can retain their own controls, but normal document reading MUST remain continuous.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The author MUST have a reorderable block outline and an insertion affordance between blocks.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Source labels/chrome MUST be available on focus/selection or through the Sources panel without making the reading surface resemble a file-manager grid.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: AI unavailability MUST not block reading the report.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A live source change MUST update the correct block while preserving the reader's stable location as far as the underlying content permits.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Explicit revision pinning MUST be visible.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Navigation back from an original editor MUST return to the corresponding Flow position.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Inline viewing is required for supported sources.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Formatting a Flow-owned heading MUST not unexpectedly restyle a source document.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Flow acceptance MUST build the Annual report example; use the same Data source twice with stable section selectors; edit the original through a permitted route; revoke source access; delete a referenced section; reorder and undo; reopen and resume reading; and verify a continuous primary scroll on desktop and mobile.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L02 — Flow reading and authoring UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: No source copy or widened permission may be introduced by composition.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L03 — Binder overview, containers and navigation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Its authoring surface MUST be a freeform overview containing clickable notes, cards, physical-style folders, binders, tabs, stacks and connected sections.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L03 — Binder overview, containers and navigation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The palette MUST provide note/card, folder, tabbed binder, stack, section/connection and supported shared content objects.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L03 — Binder overview, containers and navigation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Visual physical metaphors MUST not conceal controls or require ornamental animations to finish before the content is usable; reduced motion preserves the same navigation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L03 — Binder overview, containers and navigation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Readers choose what to explore; Binder MUST NOT force a fixed sequence or masquerade as a Paths progression system.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L03 — Binder overview, containers and navigation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Binder acceptance MUST author a folder with rich content, a tabbed binder, a stack, a referenced original and a connection; read them in a non-linear order; close back to the same overview; find an off-canvas item through the outline; follow a deep link after rename; and open the Binder from a Sheet and as a Boards page.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-L03 — Binder overview, containers and navigation
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Directly authored information, source references and all nested content MUST survive reopen without being flattened or split into unwanted files.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P01 — Product boundary and editor layout
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: It MUST be useful without AI and MUST NOT be renamed Models in menus, artifact types or launch screens.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P01 — Product boundary and editor layout
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The editor MUST provide a component/object library, an object hierarchy, a central Design surface, a Logic/relationships surface, a contextual property inspector and a Run/Preview surface.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P01 — Product boundary and editor layout
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Users MUST be able to switch between Design, Logic and Run without losing work or creating separate copies of the model.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P01 — Product boundary and editor layout
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The component library MUST include text/value outputs, numeric and text inputs, sliders, switches, buttons, selectors, tables/charts and reusable containers/components.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P01 — Product boundary and editor layout
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Controls MUST be backed by typed properties and real behaviour; a visually plausible slider disconnected from the model is not implemented functionality.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P02 — Typed model, logic and execution
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The canonical model MUST contain versioned stable object/property/component/relationship/event/action IDs, types, defaults, constraints, formulas, dependency references, layout, assets and saved authoring revision.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P02 — Typed model, logic and execution
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Numeric, Boolean, text and structured/list values MUST be distinguishable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P02 — Typed model, logic and execution
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Renaming a property MUST not break its bindings.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P02 — Typed model, logic and execution
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Derived calculations MUST follow validated dependencies.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P02 — Typed model, logic and execution
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Circular combinational dependencies, invalid types, division/domain errors and unavailable inputs MUST be surfaced at their actual source, not hidden as plausible values.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P02 — Typed model, logic and execution
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Simulations that require feedback MUST use explicit state/time-step semantics rather than relying on an uncontrolled formula cycle.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P02 — Typed model, logic and execution
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Evaluation MUST have bounded resource use, cancellation and inspectable diagnostics.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P02 — Typed model, logic and execution
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Long-running calculation MUST not block navigation or Stop.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P02 — Typed model, logic and execution
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Runtime experimentation MUST be separate from saved authoring defaults: moving a slider during a viewer session changes that session, not every reader's shared model.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P02 — Typed model, logic and execution
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Reset restores the declared initial state; reopening an authored model MUST not silently resume unintended external actions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P02 — Typed model, logic and execution
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Controlled calculations with the same revision and inputs MUST behave consistently; nondeterministic inputs and random seeds MUST be declared when used.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P03 — Safety, reuse and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Expressions and scripts MUST execute in the declared sandbox, not arbitrary host code.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P03 — Safety, reuse and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Reader preview MUST not execute consequential actions solely because an author embedded them.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P03 — Safety, reuse and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The model MUST remain inspectable when execution is blocked.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P03 — Safety, reuse and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Measured/imported values, assumptions, calculations and outputs MUST be identifiable in the inspector and relevant output presentation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P03 — Safety, reuse and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Units and declared limitations MUST be preserved.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P03 — Safety, reuse and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: AI-generated assumptions MUST not be presented as measurements or validated predictions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P03 — Safety, reuse and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Reusable components retain stable definitions and explicit dependency versions; a component update MUST not silently break existing instances.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P03 — Safety, reuse and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A reader may adjust permitted local inputs without acquiring authoring rights.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P03 — Safety, reuse and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Prototype acceptance MUST build a working calculator with two inputs, a typed formula and output; build a bounded time-based example with Run/Pause/Reset; bind a slider and switch; display a chart; reuse a component; reject invalid types and a dependency cycle; change inputs without changing saved defaults; recover from a runtime error; and prove that an untrusted script cannot reach host files or network without an authorised capability.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-P03 — Safety, reuse and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Save/reopen and API-driven edits MUST preserve the same model and behaviour.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H01 — Authoring, steps and route UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A Path may provide a guided process, exploration route or overview towards an outcome, with the available routes determined by its authored structure.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H01 — Authoring, steps and route UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The authoring editor MUST provide a step library/outline, a route graph, a selected-step content editor, a condition/action inspector and Preview/Test.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H01 — Authoring, steps and route UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Each choice MUST have a human-readable label and stable target.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H01 — Authoring, steps and route UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Conditional routing MUST expose its condition, required values and fallback/error behaviour.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H01 — Authoring, steps and route UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: No eligible route MUST show a recoverable blocked state rather than select a random next step.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H01 — Authoring, steps and route UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Multiple eligible automatic routes require an explicit authored priority/selection rule and MUST not depend on incidental storage order.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H01 — Authoring, steps and route UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Deliberate loops/retries are allowed when explicitly authored and controllable; accidental automatic loops, missing targets and unreachable required outcomes MUST be detected in validation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H01 — Authoring, steps and route UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Preview/Test MUST run against an identified draft revision with disposable test progress, offer reset and route inspection, and show the choice/condition responsible for each transition.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H01 — Authoring, steps and route UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Authors MUST be able to test alternative inputs and inspect unreachable/missing routes without modifying real users' progress.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H02 — Reader experience and durable progress
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The reader surface MUST show the current step, its content, available choices/actions, relevant checkpoint/completion status and a route/overview affordance when allowed by the authored Path.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H02 — Reader experience and durable progress
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Back/previous navigation, where permitted, MUST not repeat external side effects or silently clear completed work.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H02 — Reader experience and durable progress
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Branch-dependent length MUST not be presented as a fictitious fixed percentage; show meaningful visited/checkpoint status instead.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H02 — Reader experience and durable progress
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Progress MUST be durable and separate from authored content, with stable PathID, authored RevisionID, UserID or clearly scoped guest-session identity, AttemptID, current StepID, visited route, responses, checkpoint states, completion outcome and timestamps.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H02 — Reader experience and durable progress
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Guest/local-only progress MUST be labelled honestly and MUST NOT be represented as cross-device account sync.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H02 — Reader experience and durable progress
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: An interrupted save or duplicate transition request MUST not create duplicate completions or repeat an externally consequential action.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H02 — Reader experience and durable progress
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: When a newer revision is available, the reader MUST be told; switching/restarting requires an explicit action and a validated mapping or fresh attempt.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H02 — Reader experience and durable progress
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Deleted/changed steps MUST not cause silent jumps into a different route.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H02 — Reader experience and durable progress
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Opening an embedded file or Prototype obeys its own permissions, and completion MUST depend on an explicit typed result, not a fragile guess from visible pixels.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H03 — Integration and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: AI can help author or explain a Path through typed operations but MUST not silently replace committed routing during a reader attempt.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H03 — Integration and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Paths acceptance MUST create a branching experience with two outcomes, a required activity and checkpoint; preview both routes; detect a missing target and an automatic loop; resume a real attempt after restart; complete it twice with separate AttemptIDs; update the authored revision without corrupting an existing attempt; revoke a source permission; and prove that retrying a transition does not repeat an external action.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-H03 — Integration and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Keyboard, screen-reader and narrow-screen users MUST be able to complete the same authored route.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R01 — Explicit capture and source selection
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Optional screenshots, video and narration may accompany that record.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R01 — Explicit capture and source selection
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Capture MUST be explicitly started and limited to the selected authorised sources; opening Replay MUST NOT begin recording unrelated work or private activity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R01 — Explicit capture and source selection
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: New capture MUST present a source picker, selected files/sub-objects, available capture capabilities per owning app, destination, retention/export implications and optional media settings.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R01 — Explicit capture and source selection
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Unsupported semantic sources are identified before starting; the UI MUST not silently claim semantic capture when it can only obtain an image.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R01 — Explicit capture and source selection
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A preview of the scope MUST be available before Start.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R01 — Explicit capture and source selection
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Stop MUST stop subscriptions and selected media capture, finalise durable state and show any pending/failed material.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R01 — Explicit capture and source selection
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Losing permission to a source MUST stop future capture for that source and expose the limitation rather than continue through a cached unrestricted channel.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R02 — Semantic timeline and playback UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The editor/player MUST provide a chronological event/checkpoint timeline, source tracks/filtering, a central historical artifact viewer, a checkpoint/annotation list and an inspector showing the selected source revision and capture completeness.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R02 — Semantic timeline and playback UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Changes to Replay presentation MUST NOT rewrite the original source's history.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R02 — Semantic timeline and playback UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Playback MUST support play/pause, seek, previous/next checkpoint and adjustable playback speed for timed material.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R02 — Semantic timeline and playback UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The historical viewer MUST be visibly read-only and identify the captured revision.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R02 — Semantic timeline and playback UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: It MUST NOT resolve a checkpoint to the source's latest content merely because that is easier to load.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R02 — Semantic timeline and playback UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Capture records MUST include SessionID, authorised source identities, ordered EventIDs, event/revision provenance, CheckpointIDs, timestamps/sequence, required base revisions or validated snapshot references, annotations and media references.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R02 — Semantic timeline and playback UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: It MUST NOT depend on an ephemeral cache that disappears after the app closes.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R02 — Semantic timeline and playback UI
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: It MUST NOT restore the original over its current version or imply that a Replay viewer has edit rights to the source.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R03 — Review, sharing, failure and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Before sharing/export, Replay MUST provide an included-material review showing files, revisions, annotations, optional recordings and recipient access implications.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R03 — Review, sharing, failure and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Copy/export rights are required for retained source bytes shared independently.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R03 — Review, sharing, failure and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Excluding or redacting captured content MUST also address derived thumbnails, search text, transcripts and dependent snapshots; metadata MUST not leak a supposedly removed secret.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R03 — Review, sharing, failure and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A presentation trim alone MUST not be labelled permanent redaction.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R03 — Review, sharing, failure and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Session state MUST distinguish Not started, Recording, Paused, Finalising, Ready, Incomplete and Error.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R03 — Review, sharing, failure and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Storage/quota exhaustion, unavailable owning apps and media-device failure MUST be visible, bounded and recoverable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R03 — Review, sharing, failure and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Media failure MUST not silently destroy valid semantic checkpoints.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R03 — Review, sharing, failure and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Replay acceptance MUST capture selected changes in two supported artifacts, exclude an unrelated open file, pause/resume, create an annotated checkpoint, restart after interruption, inspect historical state after the original advances, reveal a missing dependency, stop on revoked permission and create an authorised independent copy.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-R03 — Review, sharing, failure and acceptance
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Export/share review MUST detect excluded material in thumbnails/transcripts and MUST not claim that view-only rights permit exporting source bytes.

requirements.group_title: Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V01 — Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Variants MUST ship within Write, Data, Present, Canvas, Picture, Prototype and Build site workspace.

requirements.group_title: Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V01 — Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Each supported app MUST expose a consistent Variants entry near the document/version controls.

requirements.group_title: Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V01 — Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The active variant MUST remain clearly identified in the editor title/status and save destination.

requirements.group_title: Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V01 — Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A user MUST not unknowingly type into the main version after switching to an alternative.

requirements.group_title: Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V01 — Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Autosave, undo/redo, collaboration, search/deep links and restart MUST retain the active branch identity.

requirements.group_title: Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V01 — Integrated variant UI and branch identity
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: A deep link to a variant MUST not silently open Main.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V02 — Comparison, selective merge and conflicts
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Compare MUST allow selection of base/source/target variants and provide content-appropriate side-by-side or change-focused presentation.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V02 — Comparison, selective merge and conflicts
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The interface MUST identify additions, removals, edits and conflicts, offer next/previous change and show what accepting a selected change will affect.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V02 — Comparison, selective merge and conflicts
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Colour alone MUST not convey the difference.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V02 — Comparison, selective merge and conflicts
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Merge MUST be an owning-app semantic operation against explicit source, base and expected target revisions.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V02 — Comparison, selective merge and conflicts
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Resolution must state Keep target, Use source or the supported manual choice.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V02 — Comparison, selective merge and conflicts
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: The implementation MUST NOT guess away conflicts or claim a generic byte merge is safe for every artifact type.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V02 — Comparison, selective merge and conflicts
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: If safe selective merge is unavailable for a particular content operation, the app MUST provide a faithful compare-and-choose workflow and explain its scope.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V02 — Comparison, selective merge and conflicts
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Choosing the source creates a new target revision while retaining recoverable history; it MUST NOT erase the target's earlier line.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V02 — Comparison, selective merge and conflicts
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Archive/remove MUST not delete the only retained content without the normal recovery/confirmation contract.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V03 — Required owning-app comparison semantics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Write MUST compare stable text/block structure, edits, formatting and referenced objects; text and formatting conflicts remain distinguishable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V03 — Required owning-app comparison semantics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Data MUST compare sheets/tables, stable rows/columns/cells, values, formulas, schema and named dependencies; it MUST not splice unrelated rows merely because their current indices match.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V03 — Required owning-app comparison semantics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Present MUST compare slide identity/order, objects, content, layout and presentation-level dependencies.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V03 — Required owning-app comparison semantics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Canvas MUST compare stable objects, geometry, strokes, grouping, connectors and source references.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V03 — Required owning-app comparison semantics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Picture MUST compare layers, masks, transformations, adjustments and image data using the actual supported document structure; incompatible raster edits require a visible choose/manual-resolution path rather than invented pixel-level semantic merging.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V03 — Required owning-app comparison semantics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Prototype MUST compare typed objects/properties, formulas, bindings, component definitions and relationships and validate the resulting model before commit.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V03 — Required owning-app comparison semantics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Build site workspace MUST compare pages, components, routes, content, assets and settings through Build site workspace' own model.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V03 — Required owning-app comparison semantics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Comparing, switching or merging a site variant MUST NOT publish or change production deployment by itself.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V03 — Required owning-app comparison semantics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Secrets, credentials and live provider state MUST not be copied into a branch merely because project settings are versioned.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > Other independent apps and shared capabilities > TF-V03 — Required owning-app comparison semantics
requirements.top_section: Other independent apps and shared capabilities
requirements.text: Variants acceptance MUST create, edit, switch, compare and bring changes back in all seven apps; retain the starting version; expose an overlapping conflict; exercise the safe whole-version fallback; reject a stale merge; recover after save interruption; and reopen at the selected branch.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Platform foundation and donor authority
requirements.text: The governing donor rule is preserve unless replaced: applicable Ubuntu/GNOME behaviour, hardware support, accessibility, session management, networking, Bluetooth, audio, displays, power, notifications, multi-monitor support, virtual desktops, filesystem/system integration and other mature platform behaviour MUST remain available unless this specification explicitly replaces or supersedes it.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Platform foundation and donor authority
requirements.text: Once an authoritative 9to1 app fully replaces a donor graphical application, the duplicate donor user-facing app SHOULD be removed from the default OS image.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Taskbar Layers
requirements.text: Layers may differ in item size, alignment, grouping, height and visual presentation where supported.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Taskbar Layers
requirements.text: A visible accessible layer-position indicator shows the current position and number of available layers; its presentation can be configured but must not rely on colour alone.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Taskbar Layers
requirements.text: Examples are illustrative rather than hard-coded: one user may create Running Apps, Quick Actions, AI Agents, Development and Personal layers.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Naming and conceptual separation
requirements.text: Documentation, APIs and UI MUST use these distinct names to avoid ambiguity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Desktop Spaces
requirements.text: A Desktop Space is a versioned shell/behaviour profile that may change taskbars, taskbar layers, Go layout, quick settings, notification presentation, window rules, widgets/overlays, input model, theme, animations, performance/resource profile, default actions and Dulche behaviour without requiring applications to restart where avoidable.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Desktop Spaces
requirements.text: Optional triggers may suggest or activate a Desktop Space based on convertible posture, controller connection, application launch, display configuration, schedule or other supported state; automatic activation behaviour is user-controlled.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Virtual Desktops
requirements.text: Virtual Desktops support create/delete, names, ordering, keyboard/touchpad switching, window movement between desktops, configurable transition, task-view overview, optional per-desktop wallpaper and configurable taskbar visibility across current/all desktops.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Desktop Pages and Widgets
requirements.text: Each desktop surface can contain multiple ordered Desktop Pages that users may add/remove, rename, reorder and navigate by configured gesture/scroll.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Desktop Pages and Widgets
requirements.text: Pages may contain icons, files/folders, Shelf collections, shortcuts and native CUI widgets and may be global or Desktop-Space-specific according to configuration.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Customisation Framework
requirements.text: Stable shell behaviour and presentation that can reasonably be represented as configuration SHOULD be configurable unless doing so would materially compromise security, accessibility, compatibility or system integrity.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Customisation Framework
requirements.text: The OS MUST expose substantially deeper supported first-party customisation than stock Windows or stock GNOME without requiring registry hacks, shell patches, unsupported extensions or third-party Start/taskbar replacements.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Configuration scopes and precedence
requirements.text: The implementation MUST define deterministic precedence so a Desktop-Space/display/app override cannot unpredictably conflict with global defaults.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Configuration scopes and precedence
requirements.text: Device/display-specific state must not be blindly synced to incompatible hardware.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Safe application and recovery
requirements.text: Large shell changes SHOULD support preview/keep/revert flows.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Safe application and recovery
requirements.text: Configuration schemas are versioned and migrations MUST preserve supported user state across OS updates rather than silently discarding a highly customised desktop.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Quick Settings and system flyouts
requirements.text: First-party tiles should cover relevant controls such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, airplane mode, brightness, volume/audio output, microphone, battery saver/performance mode, night light, accessibility, hotspot, VPN, display/casting, input, focus/do-not-disturb, location, screenshot/recording and Dulche/AI state.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Quick Settings and system flyouts
requirements.text: Tiles are typed CUI modules that may expose live state, icon, primary/secondary labels, toggle/action, slider and expanded view.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Quick Settings and system flyouts
requirements.text: Apps/Plugins may register tiles through a permissioned contract with declared supported sizes/actions; arbitrary shell code injection is not a tile API.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > Quick Settings and system flyouts
requirements.text: Related flyouts such as audio, network, Bluetooth, calendar, battery and notification centre must provide friendly direct controls and the expected Windows-class QoL, including optional battery percentage, output-device switching, tray overflow, date/calendar, power/session controls and useful status detail.

requirements.section: 9to1 Development Specification v2 > 9to1 OS distribution > AI settings
